de bzhin du 'gro ba gzhan yang so so'i rgyu des bskyed nas/ de de'i don byed pa yin/ thabs des dag pa'i sa thob pa rnams lha klu la sogs pa sna tshogs su skye ba len pa yin gsungs// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pas gdug pa 'dul ba dang*/ dmigs pas khams gso ba dang*/ tshogs dpon gyis tshogs pa skyong pa gsum dgos/ de la rnal 'byor pas gdug pa 'dul ba 'di la phyi nang gsang ba gsum la blo nges pas/ rten 'brel lnga mngon du gyur pa zhig dgos/ gnas dur khrod dam ri khrod kyi dgon par sdod pa'i dus su/ mi rgod chas su zhugs/ gnas brtan dam la gdags/ rdo rje'i go bskon/ pha yul bzung nyes pa spang*/ rka 'gor chu thigs gcig 'thung na khar thal ba gdab/ mtshang yul nas gdon/ ci byas kyang mi mgu zhing bstan pa'i dgrar gyur na mgo rting bzlog dgos 'dod char du dbab/ de rnams gang byed kyang srog gi gnad nas 'dzin dgos pa yin/ mi rgod kyi srog zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i chos brgyad/ rka 'gor chu thigs gcig 'thung ba'i srog nga rgyal gyis bskyed pa/ dam pa nang rgyas kyi srog zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i 'byung bzhi/ mtshang yul nas 'don cing skyon can mthar dbyung ba'i srog rku byi 'dam gsum byed pa'i grogs po/ mgo rting bzlog pa'i srog zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i srog snying rje/ dgos 'dod char du dbab pa'i srog zhing bsam dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel lo// de rnams gang byed kyang rnal 'byor pas lam du btang la shes pa lnga ldan gnad bzung ba dang*/ dngos gzhi rang he ru kar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ gang yin gyi srog la dmigs pa sgom/ rang de'i gzugs su gyur pa'i dus su yi dam lhar bsgom/ dngos gzhi gnad la btang*/ rjes byang chub kyi sems gsum gyis khrus bya/ yang gnyis pa lugs 'di bzhin du byas te/

mi rgod chas su zhugs pa ni/ ri khrod kyi dgon par sdod pa'i dus su rang dbang med par/ zhe sdang drag po skyes pa'i dus su sbyor ba lam du btang*/ tshad med pa'i byams pa bsgom/ de'i rjes la yi dam gyi lha bla ma'i mos gus bya/ rjes gnad la btang bas dang po gzhi bdag dbang du 'du/ de la dkar nag gnyis/ dkar po dbang du 'dus na lug rdzi lta bus bsnyen bkur byed/ rang gi lus la sha bkra 'ong*/ nag po 'dus na khyi ra ba'am yul de'i mi rgod dam/ ngan pa'i rigs kyis bsnyen bkur byed/ de yang rigs ni gsum du yod/ rdzas dang gnas dang yul la'o// dbang du 'dus pa'i yon tan gsum// rdzas la gnad du song gyur na// longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung*// gnas ni rdo rje'i gdan du 'gyur// zhe sdang rigs rnams 'khor du 'ong*// gnad du ma song skyon gsum ni// rdzas kyi dngos po gang yin de// chag 'bo yang na rkun mas 'khyer// rang la mi phan zhe sdang bskyed// gnas kyi dngos po gang yin des// sdod par mi 'ong 'pho skyas byed// yul gyi dngos po zhe sdang can// rnal 'byor pa la bar du gcod// de 'dra'i skyon can ngos bzung la// sbyor ba lam du btang bar bya// dngos gzhi byams pa'i gnad la dril// mjug sdud ma yengs cig shos gnad// dril nas bsgom pa gnad yin no// don de gnad du song ba'i 'bras// yul dang yul can gnyis med par// stong par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ mi rgod chas su zhugs pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// gnas brtan dam la gdags pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la/ sde bskyangs thabs/ gnyer gyi bya thabs/ yon bdag gi sri gcod pa rnams rang rang gi rgyud la ci skye bya/ de nas skyes pa dang sbyor ba lam du btang*/ lnga ldan gyi gnad la dril bas dam la thogs nas 'ong*/ kho dbang du 'dus pa dang*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis mnyes par bya/

mnyes pa'i rjes la yang sgom/ gnad la btang nas bsgoms pas/ rang gi ci dgos pa'i zhabs tog byed pa'o// slob ma dam par 'gyur ro// gnas brtan dam la gdags pa rdzogs so// rang la rdo rje'i go bskon pa ni/ sngags pa khros pa las kyi gshin rje yin pas/ des rang la gnod pa bskyal na 'byung ba rnam pa lnga'i gos gyon te/ khos sngags bzlas tshad rlung yin te/ rang 'gro ba'i dus lnga ldan gyi rjes la rlung 'tshub 'u ru ru 'gro bar bsam/ sbyin bsreg byas tshad me yin yang*/ me'i nang gi sbyin bsreg bya ba gtum mo bsgom/ mnan pa byas tshad chu yin pas/ rang mtsho'i chu mig sngo mo re bsgom/ phur pa btab tshad zor yin pas/ rang rdo rje'i brag tu bsgom/ de ltar zad par gyi skye mched 'byung bzhi'i gnad la/ lnga ldan gyi lcag gis brabs pas/ gang gis kyang phed pa mi 'gyur ro// rka 'gor chu thigs pa gcig 'thung ba ni/ yon tan nga che/ bslab pa nga rgan/ skye sa nga bzang zer ba/ mkhan po dang slob dpon nga bzang*/ kho'i zas ngas mi za na sus za/ btsun chung 'di la gtad pa ci yod zer nas rang brnyas pa'i sar 'jog na/ de'i khar thal ba gdab pa ni/ kho'i mkhan po de dang slob dpon la zhe thag pa nas rang gis gsol ba gdab/ mos gus byas rjes gnad la btang bas/ kho rang gi 'og tu thum hril gyis 'gro/ de dbang du 'dus pa dang*/ chos 'brel zhig bya/ de rjes lam du btang*/ lnga ldan gyi gnad dril/ mtshang yul nas 'don pa ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ mchod pa 'bul/ lam du btang*/ sems bskyed/ lha bsgom gang bskrad par 'dod pa de la zhe sdang gi mig 'bur tshugs su bltas la/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi 'gram du lhan gyis song bar bsam/ rjes gnad dril/ bstan pa'i dgrar gyur pa de la zhe sdang drag po bskyed de skyes pa dang rang he ru kar bsgom/ dgra bo'i khang khyim dang bcas pa lag pas blangs pas bstib/

rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam// dgos 'dod char du dbab pa ni/ rang las skyes pa'i rnam rtog de// sbyor ba lam du btang byas la// gang 'dod rdzas kyi dngos por bsam// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma'i rang bzhin phyag rgya che// srog rtsol gnas su bsdams byas la// gnad du dril bas dngos grub 'thob// na mo ratna gu ru/ 'dir gtum mo lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi man ngag gi gnad gsum gyis phyag rgya chen po rang dbang med par mi skye kha med pa yin/ tshe snga ma'i las 'phro la ltos mi dgos par 'dir 'bad pas rang gis rtogs pa yin no// de ltar gtum mo gnad gsum gyis nyams su blangs pas khyed rang gi phyag rgya chen po de/ rgyun chad med par 'ong ste/ gnyid khung du mi 'ong*/ gnyid khung du 'ong bar byed pa'i mnal 'od gsal 'dzin pa yin te/ slob dpon dpal ldan nā ro pas bzhed kyis/ nyon mongs mi spong bar lam du byed pa yin/ nyon mongs pa de dag par byed pa la/ lam du byed pa zer pa yin te/ ji ltar dag par byed na/ nyon mongs pa mi spong bar de nyid kyi shugs de dge sbyor du byed pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa'i shugs de gtum mor byed/ 'od gsal du byed/ sum chos kyis lhag pa'i lhar byed/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis nyon mongs pa spong bar byed pa yin/ nyon mongs dge sbyor du byed cing dge sbyor nyon mongs kyi dbang du gtong ba 'di dgra byung dus kyi dpa' bo yin/ des na 'dir yang gti mug 'di nyid 'od gsal du byed pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ gnyid ni spong bar mi bya ste// dbang po rnams ni mi dgag go// bya ba yin te/ gnyid de nyid phyag rgya chen por 'gro rgyu zhig yod pa yin/ de la zin na zin pa'i rgyu bzhi/ mi zin na mi zin pa'i rgyu bzhi/ de yang mos gus yod na zin/ med na mi zin/ de yang bla ma snying du song ba zhig dgos te/

snying gar pho brang rtag tu bca' ba yin te/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du shes pa bla ma dam pa dang mi 'bral bas bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang gi dge sbyor dang dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid las shes pa mi 'gyur ba'i dus 'od gsal zin te/ nyin par bya byed bag chags kyang rmi lam du 'ong na/ bla ma gnyid khung du mi 'ong ba'i don med/ des na mos gus yod na bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis 'od gsal zin pa yin te/ phag mo gru kun tu mos gus yod na 'od gsal rtsol sgrub mi dgos par zin pa yin/ spyir yang gsang sngags kyi yon tan thams cad bla ma'i mos gus las skye bar gsungs pas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges par byas la shes pa dang mi 'bral bar mos gus chen po bya'o// sgom na zin ma sgom na mi zin pas nyin par dang nam srod dang gung la yang 'bad pa chen pos gtum mo bsgom/ 'dir nyin par gtum mo bsgom/ nub mor 'od gsal 'dzin/ nyin par sgyu lus sgom/ nub mo rmi lam 'dzin pa 'brel pa can du bzhed par gda'o// de ltar gtum mo la 'bad pa chen po byas pas dub pa dang*/ tho rangs kyi dus su 'od gsal 'dzin pa yin/ srod dang dgung la 'od gsal zin pa dka'/ tho rangs kyi dus su tshegs med par zin pa yin te/ slob dpon dpal ldan nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ sngar gyi goms pas dkri ba dang*/ dgug pa'i dus dag shes pa'o// bya ba gsungs pas/ tho rangs dgug pa'i dus yin pas dge sbyor byas pas dub pa'i dus su bzung*/ zin na nyin par dang khyad med par 'ong ste/ ngas sngon skyi shod du za rgyu ni med/ thang chad lam khar bye ma'i gseb tu gnyid pas/ gnyid khung du byi'u co ga 'gyur ba de kho na bzhin du thos de nas dgon pa zhig tu phyin pas/ grogs po zhig gis ci za ci 'thung byin/ khos za rgyu 'di tsam ster ci yin snyam pa byung*/ gzod go ste 'od gsal de'i byin rlabs su 'dug

gnyid du song bya byed gang yang sgrib pa med par/ gnyid du ma song yang sad rgyu yod nyams kyi 'od gsal yin/ de'i thog tu nyin par gyi phyag rgya chen po tshur drangs nas bsgom pa yin/ lar 'bad pas sgom na tshegs med par 'ong ste/ nga sngon byis par ni song gnyid ni che/ tshong pa mdzo ded pa'i phyi na phar 'gro ba dang gnyid gnyis ka 'ong bar 'dug khyed gnyid pa dang sgom pa gnyis mi 'ong ba'i don ci yod/ gsum pa dam tshig yod na zin med na mi zin/ de la dam tshig bcu bzhi dang bco lnga pa yan lag dang bcas pa yang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yin te/ 'dir khams byang chub kyi sems yod na sdom gsum yang 'di yin par bzhed pas/ 'di nan tan chen pos sum chos kyi gnad kyis nyams su blangs shing ma nyams par byas pas tshegs med par zin te/ 'di yod na mkha' 'gro yang 'di la zer ba yin te/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang rang gi lus la yod pa yin/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad 'byon pa yin/ byon nas ci byed na rang la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad ster ba dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo la gdan 'dren pa dang*/ grub chen brgyad sman bcud len rdzas gang yang rung ba gcig bzos pas tshe lo bye bar thub pa dang*/ gzhan yang nam mkhar 'gro ba dang*/ chu la mi bying ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung dpag tu med pa ston pa dang*/ yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ khams byang chub sems dwangs pa las byung*/ dwangs ma 'dod chags med pa khams byang chub kyi sems nyon mongs pa gsum gyis ma gos pa'i dus su yang bla ma'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ gdams ngag zhu ba dang yi dam zhal mthong ba gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa zhu ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad mthong ba dang*/ yon tan zad pa'i mtha' med pa 'byung*/ rang dbang med par ting nge 'dzin bzang po skye/

gnyid thams cad 'od gsal du rtsol sgrub mi dgos so// gdams ngag yod na zin/ med na mi zin te/ rgyu bzhi po dgug pa'i dus shes par bya ba/ gnyid mthug na gong ma bsgom zhing lus tsog pu skyil krung pus mo la sngas byas nas bzung ba dang*/ gnyid bsrab nas ma zin na dmigs pa 'og ma sgom zhing seng ge'i nyal stabs bya'o// 'di'i dus su lus ngag yid gsum tshar bcad pa dang rjes su bzung ba dang*/ rang sor bzhag pa gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// lar bu kun 'bad pa chen pos gyis dang*/ 'dir bla ma'i spyan sngar nyams su blangs pas nyams bag tsam skye/ de ri khrod du bsgom pas mis ma tshor bar grub thob tu song zin 'ong ba yin/ yon tan chen po skyes zin 'ong ba yin/ rang gis kyang ma tshor bar re ba med pa la grub thob chen por gyur zin pa 'ong*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba la tshegs med pa yin/ ri khrod kyi dgon pa na phar la song*/ 'bad pa chen po gyis/ 'od gsal thon chos lags so gsungs// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'dod chags drag po skyes pa'i dus de khams snyigs ma/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dus nas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba de cung zad dwangs pa yin/ phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa shin tu dwangs pa yin/ gzhan yang dkar po snyigs ma yin/ dmar po cung zad dwangs/ sngon po shin tu dwangs pa yin te/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sngon por 'ong ba yin/ nyams pa sla/ ma nyams na gar/ yang zhal snga nas/ bar chad dang grib bsrung ba la/ gnod byed dang bar du gcod pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed/ rang nyid dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad yum du gyur pa rje btsun bcom ldan 'das mar bsgom/ de'i gnas gsum sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po bzhugs par bsam/

de nas rim pa bzhin du 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das thams cad yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi bzlas pa bya/ bar chad bslu ba'i mchog yin/ yang dbu zhwa la dpal phag mo gru pa'i sku 'bag bzhugs pa la rgyu mtshan lnga yod de/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi phyag dang bsnyen bkur la sogs pa byas pas de phul bas tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ gnyis pa 'bangs kyis jo bor 'khur ba dang 'dra bar rin po che yin la bdag g.yog po yin pas 'khur ba dang*/ gsum pa slob ma rnams la rdzun mi zer ba'i dpang por bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhi pa rgya la nyon mongs pa dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis sems skyes na/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan nas khyed rnams kyis skyabs su gsol zhes pas skyabs su mchi ba dang*/ lnga pa grib dang nad yams la sogs pa bsrung ba yin/ yang sems can thams cad dge ba bcu bzhi la bkod pa bas/ sems can gcig sems bskyed shes pa dang ma 'dres kyang lan gcig bskyed pa bsod nams che/ yang stong gsum rin po ches bkang nas bla mar phul ba bas/ rang nyid kyis sngo tshod dam skyo tsha phor gang tsam la kha zas kyi rnal 'byor byas nas zos pa bsod nams che gsungs pa yang dpal shrī ri phug pas de'i rigs thams cad la/ rang yi dam du bsgoms pas rang bsrung*/ de nas phyi rol de yang der bsgom pas rang yang bstim la phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ bla ma yi dam la sogs pa bzang ltas byung na rtog dpyod mi bya bar yan lag bdun pa shin tu bsdus pa zhig bya/ de nas sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po rtog dpyod byas na bsam pa 'gyur nas phyi rol gyi de yang rang gi sems yin pas 'gyur te bla ma yel pa 'byon// yang zhal snga nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi thams cad gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i bsam pa rkyang pa dang tshig rkyang pa 'di yin/

yang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis ma phye ba'i rig pa 'di rtogs na mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi yin/ ma rtogs na 'khor ba'i gzhi yin gsungs*/ yang mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa byas pa yang 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung bzhi rnam shes la thim dbu mar 'jug ste dbu ma kha bye ba'i dus su rkang pa shi 'bras byed/ bye ba'i dus su mig har gyis 'ong ba yin/ gsang sngags kyi 'og min spyi bo yin pas/ bla ma spyi bor bsgoms pa'i gnad kyis rtsa mdud thams cad gcig tu byang nas sgrib pa thams cad 'dag ste/ sangs rgyas sku gsum dbyer med du mchi ba dang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i bla ma'i zhabs drung du skyes nas sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin/ yang bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes dgos te bdag thub pa'i sras rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bya ba ni/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gsum yin pas nyams su blangs/ gzhan thams cad bya ba ma yin pas spang bar bya'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos gsang sngags de la dbang gi go ba ni/ rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched dam/ lus ngag yid gsum yin pa de ngo sprod pa la dbang zer ba yin/ bla ma byin rlabs dang ldan pa yang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs skad cig kyang ma bral ba de la zer/ de la mos gus byas pas dbang thob pa yin/ smin pa dang grol bar byed pa la bskal pa mang po la bsgrub shing me tog phog pa'i lha de bsgom pa bskyed rim yin la/ dam tshig ni tha mal du 'khrul na dam tshig nyams/ las mi dge ba bcu 'bras bu ngan song gsum du skye ba 'chad/ 'o na gsang sngags nas/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// ma byin pa yang blang bar bya// la sogs pa gsungs snyam na/ rnam rtog gi srog rlung yin pas/ de bkag pas rnam rtog srog 'chad pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa rang la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yod pa de sus kyang byin pa med/

rang gis rtogs par byed pa yin pa dang*/ rdzun la sogs pas kyang de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa yin pas/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum du gyur na sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig nyams/ de yang gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig ma nyams par byed pa la/ nang par gyi dus su/ oṃ nas bzung ā li tshar gcig dgong mo ā li'i rjes swā hā btags pa tshar gcig brjod pas de'i nyin par ci smras pa thams cad ā li kā lir 'gro ba yin/ gnyis pa sgra thams cad grags stong du shes pa gsung gi dam tshig gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa rlung la sogs kyang yin mod kyi rje sgam po dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pa phyag rgya chen po la bzhed pa yin gsungs// yang zhal lnga nas/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad bde bas byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis byang chub sgrub pa gnyis yin/ de la nges pa mi 'dug ste/ dpal nā ro pa chen pos dka' chen rnam pa bcu gnyis spyad pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pas smon lam nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum btab pa rang gis sangs rgyas thob pa lta bu lam bde ba yin/ yang nye ring zer te nges pa mi 'dug rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin/ nga snyam na dbang yin snyam/ pha rol tu phyin pa la rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang yod du ma tshor te/ phal chen nas sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa bas/ khyad par dbang bskur ba yin gsung*// //oṃ swa sti/ sku gsum yon tan 'phrin las sogs// mthar phyin ma rtogs sems can la// thugs rje rgyun chad mi mnga' bas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad la 'dud// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyis// rang gzhan bde skyid sgrub pa yis// shin tu zab pa'i chos 'khor bskor// brjed kyi dogs pas tho tsam bri// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ ri khrod dam phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang du 'gro ba yang*/ don gyi bya ba bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'am/

mdor bsdus na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa tshe 'di dang phyi ma gang bsgrub kyang*/ 'gro ba'i bsam pa gtong ba'i dus nas sa phyogs de byin gyis rlob dgos te/ bsam pa gang bskyed pa de'i 'bras bu 'byin pas/ phyi yul la chags pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas phyin na/ za rgyu dang 'thung rgyu med pa'i sa phyogs shig tu yong ba rten 'brel yin/ rgya la yod kyang ster du mi btub/ dper gyis na 'di na za rgyu med na tsā ri 'dra ba zhig tu phyin na za rgyu 'di bas drag ste yong snyam nas phyin na za rgyu ye mi rnyed/ sngo dang rngad yod pa kun kyang gab nas mi rnyed pa yin te/ brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ bya ba yin/ 'di la gdams ngag tu ni/ za rgyu med pa de bla ma dang dkon mchog la tshogs ma bsags pas lan pa yin pas/ da ngas bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tu ri khrod la phyin la bsgrub pa bya/ sngo rngad la sogs pa rnams kyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod snyam nas bsam pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas phyin na/ gong ma las ldog pa yin te/ rab yin na lam du zhugs nas za rgyu yong*/ 'bring sgrub pa la zhugs nas 'ong*/ tha ma yang dge sbyor skyes nas 'dzoms chil 'gro ba yin/ za bar 'dod pa de la yi dwags kyi sems zer ba yin/ des za rgyu gar rnyed/ nang sems can la chags pa'i bsam pas rjes su 'brangs nas phyin na/ sdom pa 'chor ba dang skur pa phog pa la sogs 'ong*/ zhe sdang gi song na yul der khrag 'khrug sad ser la sogs pa mang po yong ste/ zhe sdang gi mes rang bsreg 'od kyis gzhan bsreg pa yin/ gti mug gi song na thos bsam sgom gsum gang gis kyang shes rab mi skye/ phrag dog gi song na 'di nyes pa che shos yin pas/ don gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad zad par byed pa yin/ dkon mchog gsum gnas dus kyi bskal pa nas ming yang mi thos/ tha ma yul mtha' 'khob tu phyin nas ba lang mang po'i rdzi bor 'gyur ba yin/

phyag rgya chen po ni yang dag tshangs byas pa yin/ 'di ngas gdams ngag gsum bya yis phyag rgya chen po yod na sems can thams cad kyis bkur sti yong ba yin mod/ chos sku la phrag dog ga na skye/ 'bring yi dam gyi lhar yong ba yin te yi dam gyi lha la phrag dog pa'i don med/ tha ma na yang sems can thams cad pha ma yin mod pha ma la phrag dog byed pa ga na gda'/ nga rgyal gyi rjes 'brangs nas lta sgom spyod gsum tsam du sus chog pa med snyam nas rang nyid bzang bar byas/ gzhan ngan par spyad na nag hrul gyis 'gro ba la tshegs med/ khyed rang 'khor skyong ba rnams kyang yon tan khyed bas che na bla mar 'os pa yin te/ chos sam gcig tu re nas 'khor ba yin mod/ de la ci 'ong mi shes pa zhig 'dug byas nas khyad du bsad pas mi 'ong*/ rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis sngar nyin phra men ma lnga brgya bsad/ phyi nyin bram ze brgyad khri'i ske dus gcig breg pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ zang zing 'bul ba rnams kyi nang nas rgyal po gtum po rab snang yin gsungs nas mi 'di tsam pa bsad pas rgyal po sdig pa can yin mi gsungs bar 'dug nyes pa sna re re tsam byas pa de ngan par gcod pa de gcig tu yul chung ba yin/ gnyis su thub pa'i gsung rab ma mthong ba yin/ gsum par na rang skyon can yin te rang la rtogs pa yod na sems can thams cad chos skur yong ba yin mod/ chos kyi sku la chos sku'i yon tan yod/ de la dad gus byas pas rang la yang de'i yon tan yong ba yin mod/ nga yod ma myong pa la khyad par chos nga rgyal rgyu ci yod/ bla ma nyag se skam po gnas nang du byon/ khang pa phub pas/ 'khor gnyis shi ba dang*/ gcig btsad pos phyag 'tshal du re ba'i ched du lo tsā slob tu phyin pas bsad/ de gnyis ka nga rgyal gyis nyes pas/ des na dug lnga'i bsam pas kun nas blangs nas/ 'di dang 'dir 'gro dgos snyam pa byung na/

rtog pa de mnan/ rtog pa ngan pa de 'dra ba mi skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ sems can du song bas rtog pa ngan pa mi skye ba mi yong snyam na rtog pa de skad cig ma mi rtag pa yin mod/ ji ltar sgyur bsgyur btub par gda' ba/ dug lnga gang rung ba'i bsam pa'i rjes su 'brang nas 'di dang 'dir 'gro dgos snyam pa'i rtog pa de la sems zer/ phyis der 'gro ba de de'i las yin/ phyin pa'i sa der cig bza' snyam pa srid pa de/ dpe ci dang 'dra snyam na sngar gnod pa bskyal bskyal ba'i mi gcig rang gi rtsar byung na 'thab pa'i grabs byed pa yin mod/ de dang khyad med/ sngar bsam pa zhig skyes pa de'i 'bras bu la longs spyod pa ma gtogs pa mi srid par gda' ba/ bsam pa dug lnga'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gang byas kyang nga bdag de'i rgyan ma rtogs pa mi srid/ ngas khyed la bslab kyis gzhan la phrag dog dang nga rgyal zhog la/ rang yon tan dang ldan par gyis/ rtog pa ngan pa thams cad phyag rgya chen pos med par byas nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la bsnyen pa bya/ de la bskyed pa'i lha bsgom/ de nas bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ yang de las skyes pa'i 'gro dgos snyam pa de la sems zer/ 'gro ba de de'i las yin/ phyin pa'i sa der yang sngar rang nyid la phan btags pa'i mi zhig byung ba dang khyad med par 'ong*/ gong gi bsam pa de'i 'bras bu yin/ rtog pa gcig ma skyes na'ang ma skyes/ skyes phan chad de'i spu ris nges par mi 'byung mi srid/ dang po'i rtog pa de la sa bon zer ba yin/ zhe 'dod kyi bsam pa rgyun du yod pa de zhing sa yin/ lus ngag gi dge ba de myur du smin par byed de rkyen chu lud yin/ zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis mthong chos 'bras bu myur du 'byung zer/ rgyud tshod la mtho dman chen po med/

rgyu 'bras skad cig ma las byung ba nyid slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba nga rgyal gyis chu'i gting du song ba/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bya ba zhes pas steng du thon pa dang*// dpal phag mo gru pa'i sku khams la brag zhun phan par byung ba la/ pho rog gis mang po bskyur byung ba dang*/ jo mo lha rje mas dgong mo sa bon btab pas nang mo bsrub tu smin nas phyugs rdzi la byin pa dang*/ rje btsun chen pos ri la mi 'byon/ dbu bsnyung bro khar bzhes nas ri la bros/ dgong mo thugs dam mdzad pa dang*/ dbu 'gas pa tsam du snyung ba dang*/ mdun du bud med mang pos mchi ma sham mo byas nas/ rje btsun thugs ma yengs par thugs dam mdzad par zhu 'o zer ba dang*/ yengs pa med par sgoms pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du ri khrod du bzhud dgos snyam pa dang po'i thugs bskyed de de'i mthus mod la de rlung dbu mar tshud de/ de la bla ma zer ba yin/ nang mo bla ma zhig gis mos gus brjed pas/ nyi ma phyed khyi ra ba dam pa rgya gar de la sogs pa zhed pa med/ de kun las kyang myur ba rang nyid la bsam pa bzang po skyes pa'i dus su ji ltar 'dod pa tsug 'ong*/ bsam pa ngan pa skyes pa'i dus su phyi dngos kyi snang ba yang 'gyur nas 'gro bar gda' ba de la zer ba yin/ rang pho sgo mtho bas byung snyam pa srid de de min/ 'di la rten 'brel zer/ rgyu 'bras kyang zer/ ci 'dra ba'i las byas pa de 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba yin/ da gdams ngag gal che shos la/ rang nyid 'gro ba'i sa phyogs der rje btsun spyan ras gzigs su bsgom pa dang*/ byams pa bsgom pa gal che/ byams pa bya ba gdung ba'i shugs drag pos gnod pa'i las byed mi phod pa de la zer ba yin/ de stobs cher song nas sdug bsngal bar 'dug pa de la ma bzod pas snying rje skye ba yin/ de la byang chub kyi sems skye ba yin/

'di gsum yod na gzhan gyis kyang tshor nas thams cad 'du ma yong byas kyang yong*/ ci yod pa 'bul ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ 'di gsum med na nga yon tan can yin/ nga'i rtsar sdod byas pas ga la nyan/ tshan gcig na re nyan thos dang byang chub sems khyad par sems can gyi don byed mi byed dam snying rje yod med yin zer te de min/ sems can gyi don yang byed snying rje yang yod de 'bras bu sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas mi 'dod par rang nyid zhi ba 'dod pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ sems can thams cad kyi don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ni byang chub sems zer ba yin/ de gsum la thog mar rang sangs rgyas nas/ gzhan sgrol bar 'dod pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod nas rang gdod sangs rgyas bar 'dod pa dang*/ rang dang sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba de'i ched du lam nyams su len pa gsum las nged cag phyi ma 'di'i rjes su 'brang*/ 'di bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pa yin/ don hril gyis dril na byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems yod na/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi gnas su phyin kyang sdug bsngal mi yong la bde ba 'ba' zhig tu 'ong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying po'i gtam rgyud dang chos smra ba rnams kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa byams ma'i bu gang po'i gtam rgyud dang*/ bran mo bu la byams pas mtshams sbyar nas shi bas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa dang*/ me'i nang du 'chi ba la ngo tsha ba dran nas lus ras kyis dril nas shi bas lhar skyes pa dang*/ rgyal bu snying stobs chen pos stag mo la lus sbyin yang byams pa'i shugs chen pos za ma nus pa dang*/ de la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzhan la gnod pa ci byas kyang rang nyid byas pa yin/ phyir ngos na dgra med snang ba rang sems yin/ de ltar min na zhe sdang gis dmyal ba/

chags pa dang gzhan la rku 'phrog gis yi dwags su skye ba mi gsha' ste skye bar 'dug byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems yod na thams cad kyis bkur bar gda'/ de rang nyid kyis rang nyid la bsgrub pa yin mod/ byams pa rgyun chad med pa dka'/ dper na mun khung du glog byung na de'i 'od la brten nas shad kyis spyil por phyin nas sgo gcod pa yin/ de dang 'dra bar byams pa la sogs pa bsam pa bzang po nam skye ba'i dus su de la 'jug pa gal che/ dus rtag tu kho mi 'ong*/ rkun ma byung dus su 'dzin dgos pa yin/ de la dus gnad la mkhas pa zer ba yin/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi// bdag gzhan don 'byung mi zad rgyan gyi rgyu// 'phrin las gzhir gyur spang zhing blangs pa yin// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma mnyes nas su// stobs bcu mi 'jigs glang chen seng ge'i khri// ma chags padma thabs dang shes rab gdan// nyi zla gnyis spras lhun grub khri la bzhugs// sa bcu'i mgon po rgya mtsho lta bus bskor// gsung gi gsang ba zhal gyi sgo phye ste// mtshan mchog bzang po dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po padma rkyang mdzad de// brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs kyi nying khu mchog /rgyud sde kun gyi gnad kyi bcud phyungs pa// sde snod kun gyi rtsi thog snying po ste// sa yi snying po zhun mar dril ba'i gnad// nyams su blangs na dngos grub 'byung ba'i chos// mi brjed gzungs med 'gro ba dman pa yis// dran pa gso phyir cung zad yi ger bkod// dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das ma lus pa// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba yis// nam mkha' dang mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan 'khor myur du thob par shog /lug gi lo chos kyi 'khor lo'i zla ba/ tshes drug gi dgong mo dge 'dun rnams kyi spangs shing blangs pas mnyes nas gsungs pa lags so// dge'o//

753) ༄// gsang ba rten 'brel zab mo'i gdams pa dbon rin po ches zin bris// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas khyed rang phyi rol tu 'gro 'dug bya 'dod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas blangs nas 'gro ba dang*/ bla ma rin po ches khyed rang la ji ltar bstan pa'i gdams pa rnams ma bsnyel bar byas nas bya ba dang byed pa ci byed kyang bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dgos pa lags/ de ltar du bgyis pas dang po rang nas byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ba lags/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa la tshegs med/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang bgyi ba gsung*/ lam phun sum tshogs pa de ma skyes pa skye dgos/ skyes pa gong nas gong du bogs dbyung ba la 'bad dgos pa lags/ de ltar ma gyur pa zhig tu song na/ dang po rang nas phung 'dre la zad pa'i mtha' med pa zhig 'byung ste/ gar phyin pa'i sa thams cad du 'khrug pa dang sems can la gnod 'dzug tu 'gro ba dang*/ rang gi rgyud la yon tan skye bar 'dod kyang mi skye ba dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa thams cad kyang yag lugs su mi 'grub pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la'ang gting gnad du mi 'gro ba lags/ de ltar yang*/ sems nyid dang ba rtogs pa'i 'od gsal ma mchis par// byams dang snying rje'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar 'dod pa yi// skyes bu de ni g.ya' ma las byas me long blta// zhes gsungs pa lta bu lags/ de gang yin na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo dag g.ya' ma las byas pa'i me long blta bar 'dod kyang bzhin gsal bar mi nus/ de bzhin du 'dir yang bsam pa rnam par ma dag pas gzhi ma byas pa zhig tu song na yon tan rgyud la skye bar 'dod kyang mi skye gsung*// gzhan yang nged rang thams cad la nad dang gnod pa 'di'ang bag chags kyis 'byung ba lags/ de'ang sngar gyi rgyu ngan pa sngon du song ba las byung ba yin/

'o na de 'dag pa'i thabs yod dam med snyam na/ de yod de sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas rang lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ de'ang phyi yi dam gyi rnam pa la/ nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu gtsang sing nge ba la srog rtsa ka ba lta bur bsam/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gnas su bla ma rin po che bsgom/ de nas rlung 'jam rlung bzung*/ me'i dmigs pa 'jam po la bslab/ de ltar na sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 'dag pa la tshegs med/ khams shin tu dwangs pa'i dus su dmigs pa dma' ba dang*/ glod pa shin tu gal che/ dmigs pa mi 'chun pa bzhin gcun na rta shi g.yag 'gyel la 'gro bas gzab par bya'o// de'ang sngon gyi dus nad pa zhig la dmigs pa bstan pas phan du ma 'dod/ der spyan sngar zhus pas/ ci tsug byung shod dang gsung*/ dmigs pa glod na drag pa bzhin du byung byas pas/ spyan snga nas shin tu mnyes nas rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs pa yod/ gzhan yang rma la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su dmigs pa sgom pa gal che/ de ji ltar snyam na/ rma'i nang du bla ma'i sku sran ma phyed gshags tsam zhig bsgom pa lags/ de'ang khams kyis spyod na shin tu dmigs pa brtan par nyams su len/ khams kyis ma thub na glod pa lags/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas rma rub pa dang*/ sos pa la tshegs med pa yin/ de'ang gsang ba'i rten 'brel 'di ma nyams zhing brtan pa gal che/ 'di ma nyams na mgo chag nas klad pa'i rgya ral ba la thug kyang sos pa la tshegs med/ yon bdag pho mo la sogs pa la ston na/ dmigs pa'i rten jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom du 'jug /'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i gsung sgros bris pas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig/ // 754) ༄// grib sel mnol tshangs ma dbon rin po ches bsgrigs pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i grib sel thun mong ma yin pa 'di la/ phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid dang bzhi'o// de la phyi yi ge gsum gyi srog sbyang la 'od zer gsum gyi don sbyang ba dang gcig

nang snang ba rgyas btab pa la rig pa gnas 'pho ba mi 'gyur ba dang gnyis/ gsang ba nam mkha' la mda' 'phen shes rab dbyings su thim pa dang gsum/ yar mar ni kha sbyar/ hūm̐ gi gnad rig pa'i rtsal gyis mi 'gyur bar bya'o// dang po gnas gsum du/ yi ge gsum rig pa ngar dang bcas pa 'od zer gsum gyis nang gang nas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyu ru ru bsam pas bsrung/ sib sib phar 'phros pas sel/ nad gdon 'go nad tshan chen po'i dbang du 'gro na/ rgya mi che tsam gang bar bya/ gnyis pa thugs kar rig pa hril gyis rtse gcig tu hūm̐ dkar po la bsdus pa dang*/ 'dus pa dang*/ yul gang yang rung ba la rtse gcig tu phyir bzung*/ gnyis med du bsring*/ yul de las bzhag tu mi reg go/ /gsum pa hūm̐ dkar po hril le ba las yar gu lu lu ba la shes pa nang du rtse gcig tu gtad/ steng 'og rlung kha sbyar la/ sna g.yon du bud nas dbyings su shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad nas 'ja' yal ba ltar ro/ /gsum ga la gnyis med kyi rgyas ring bar gdab par bya'o// de kho na nyid snang srid zil gyis mnan la/ mnyam gzhag ma 'gags pa'i rtsal gyis snang ba lam du 'khyer/ rig pa ngar 'don pa'i brtul zhugs kyis nyams su blang ngo*// yul mdze pho la sogs pa yin yang*/ rtog med kyis zil gyis mnan la/ mnyam gzhag ma 'gags pa'i rtsal gyis snang ba lam du 'khyer ba/ rig pa ngar 'don pa'i brtul zhugs kyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// rje'i zhal nas/ grib ka ba'am rtsigs pa re lde la spos kyang chog gsung*/ nan ltar na dgra la btang bas chog gsung ngo*// nang gi skabs su stod lung jag pa shar mo'i gtam rgyud kyang yid ches par bya ba'i phyir du bstan/ 'di grib sel mnol tshangs ma zhes bya ba shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa'o// // 755) ༄// sgom thag gi rnam bzhag/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgom thag la/ rgyud nas mchod phyir thogs zhes pa'am/

sangs rgyas rol pa zhes pa'i ming du 'dogs pa la/ rigs lnga'i dbang du byas na mi bskyod pa'i rigs yin/ pha rol phyin pa drug gi dbang du byas na bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o// 'di'i tshad ni/ rab rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i ser mo'i rtse nas/ dpung mgo g.yon pa'i bar yin la/ 'bring sor mo rnams bkug nas sog pa'i bar yin no// tha ma the bong la bskon nas dpung mgo'i bar yin no// de bas ring ba'am thung ba la yang 'gal ba med de/ rab gnas mi chags pa ma yin gsung*/ 'di'i rab gnas byed par 'dod pas/ dang por mchod pa bshams/ de nas sgom thag de nyid cho ga yan lag gsum gyis mi bskyod par krong gi bskyed la mchod pa 'bul/ gsol ba gdab gsung*/ 'di lus la 'jug pa'i dus su bsam blo cang yang mi dgos gsung*/ 'di rje rin po ches/ mi las gnang ba'i chos drug gsar ma'i khrid chos gnang ba'i dus su/ gong gi bla ma rnams kyis/ thabs lam la gtso bor pus 'khyud bcug pa kho na 'dug pas/ nyid kyis kyang phyag srol de ltar du gnang ba las/ phyis kyi dus dmigs pa 'di dang*/ sgom thag bcug dgos pa'i gtan tshig lung dang bcas nas mdzad pa yin gsung nas/ 'bu ya ras pa la gdams pa'o// // 756) ༄// sgrol ma skyabs bdun ma'i gsol 'debs// ma skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings na// yum rje btsun lha mo sgrol ma bzhugs// de sems can kun la bde ster ma// bdag 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol// rang chos sku yin pa ma shes pas// sems nyon mongs dbang du gyur pa yi// ma 'khor ba 'khyams pa'i sems can la// yum lha mo khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// chos snying nas rgyud la ma skyes par// tha snyad tshig gi rjes 'brangs nas// grub mtha' ngan pas bslus pa la// yum yang dag gi lha mos bskyab tu gsol// rtogs par dka' ba rang gi sems// mthong nas bsgom par mi byed par// bya ba ngan pas yengs pa la// yum dran pa'i lha mos bskyab tu gsol// sems rang byung gnyis med ye shes la// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyis// ji ltar byas kyang bcings pa rnams// thugs gnyis med kyi lha mos bskyab tu gsol// yang dag gi don la gnas byas kyang*// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi shes pas// shes bya'i don la rmongs pa la// yum kun mkhyen gyi lha mos bskyab tu gsol// spros bral nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can// thams cad de dang dbyer med kyis// da dung slob pa'i gang zag la// yum rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bskyab tu gsol//

lte ba nas padma mkha' 'gro rnams kyis/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar yeng gis btegs nas/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su rtsen gyis byon par bsams la 'og rlung lan gsum 'then/ yang gong gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis me tog la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul gong ltar bstan pas snying ga nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyis yeng gis btegs nas/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su rtsen gyis byon par bsam la/ 'og rlung lan gsum then/ yang gong gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis cho 'phrul bstan pas/ mgrin pa nas las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis btegs nas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su byon par bsams la/ 'og rlung lan gsum then/ de'ang mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba rnams su phyir dbab/ thun mtshams su rje btsun ma gsang gnas su rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba la bzhugs par bsams la/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya/ de ltar khug pa nyer cig gam brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgoms pas/ snang ba la rol mo'i sgra dang*/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba la sogs pa mngon sum du byung na 'byongs pa'i tshad do// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'chi ltas tshang ba dang*/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang mched grogs la tshogs kyis mnyes par byas la/ bla ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gong ltar bsgom/ rje btsun ma/ lte ba/ snying ga/ mgrin pa rnams su rim gyis byon par bsams la/ mgrin par phyi dbugs chad la khad kyi bar du bsdad/ dbugs 'gro ba dang de nas las kyi mkha' 'gros/ mgrin pa nas spyi bor gdan drangs/ spyi bo nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyis/ bla ma'i thugs kar gdan drangs/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma dang rang sems gsum dbyer med pa ste/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis me tog gi char/ 'ja'i tshogs/ spos kyi ngad/

rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bde chen mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ des rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa mngon sum du 'ong zhing rdo rje 'chang gi drung du bla ma dang gnyis su med par 'tshang rgya'o// rje mar pa'i sras shig lce chung la mda' phog nas/ 'pho ba 'di mdzad pas thod pa mtheb gang pa tsam zhig yar nas/ nam mkha' la 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang bar gda'// // 758) ༄// rje mar pa'i zhal gdams 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma'i gdams pa// yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di skye bar byed pa'i rgyu dang*/ gnas par byed pa'i gzhi dang*/ 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen dang gsum yin gsungs/ de la skye bar byed pa'i rgyu ni/ dang po rdo rje'i lus 'di 'grub pa yang*/ pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po dang*/ ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po gnyis las grub cing*/ de nas pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po smin mtshams su gnas/ des so dang sen mo/ skra dang rus pa/ rkang dang chu rgyus thams cad bskyed par byed/ ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo dang padma'i ze 'bru'i rtse mor gnas/ des sha dang khrag bkrag dang mdangs thams cad skyed par byed pa'i rgyu lags/ gnyis pa gnas par byed pa'i gzhi yang*/ thig le dkar dmar gnyis po de gnas ma 'chugs par so sor ji srid gnas kyi bar du rdo rje'i lus 'di 'jig mi srid de/ gnas pa'i gzhi byed pa yin/ gsum pa 'jig pa'i rkyen ni/ thig le gnyis po de gnas 'chugs na rdo rje'i lus 'di cis kyang 'jig pa yin te/ de yang pha las thob pa'i thig le mar 'ong ba dang*/ ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po yar 'ongs pa gnyis rtsa dbu ma'i nang du gti mug gis 'phrad pa yin/ de'i rtags su sprel dkar sna dmar bzhon nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba rmi lam du 'ong*/ de byung na ltas ngan chen po'i rmi lam yin pas/ cis kyang mi phan/

rdo rje'i lus 'di myur du 'jig pa yin/ 'o na de la bcos yod dam med snyam na/ kha chem 'jog long tsam zhig yong*/ lar bzlog pa ni mi srid pa yin/ de la bcos ni/ de lta bu rmis pa'i dus su/ rmi lam nang du bcos red na rab/ de ltar ma red na/ gnyid sad pa dang lus sems thams cad mi bde nas 'gyur snying 'dod pa 'ong*/ de'i dus su snying rus byas la/ gzhogs ma 'gyur bar/ rmi lam rmi dus kyi 'khrul 'khor de gtan nas ma zhig par bya/ 'khrul 'khor de zhig na bcos byas ma byas med/ de nas dang po lam du btang ste/ bdag gi rmi lam ngan pa 'dis bdag dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rmi lam ngan pa 'di dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur cig ces rgyud la stabs kyi ma skyes kyi bar du lam du btang*/ lam du thengs pa'i rtags/ lus sems thams cad bde 'bol gyis 'gro/ de'i dus su sems bskyed de/ lus yi dam gyi lhar wal gyis bsgom/ rje rin po che snying gi dbus su dran tsam bya/ de nas phyag rgya chen po la lhan gyis mnyam par bzhag rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba bya/ de ltar gsha' ma zhig gnad du song na/ lo re tsam thub pa yang yod/ de ma thub na zla re zla gnyis tsam kha chems 'jog long tsam 'ong ba yin pas kha chems chos dang mthun pa bzhag 'pho ba sbyong ba la sogs pa tshe phyi ma'i don sgrub pa gal che/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ bcos 'di byang chub kyi sems sprin gseb tu sbed pa'i man ngag bya ba yin/ dpe ci dang 'dra na/ rta rgod cig thag pa bzang po zhig gis phur pa bzang po zhig la btags na/ rta de thengs gcig 'grogs nas 'ong yang*/ tshur sgar gyis 'ong ba dang 'dra bar/ chos 'di gsha' ma zhig red na/ thig le gnyis po de/ de rang du ci rigs lhan du gnas/ der ji srid gnas kyi bar la mi 'chi/ de nas gnyis po de yan man du 'chugs na/

tshe'i dus byed pa'i dus su/ sna bug nas chu ser dmar brlan pa thigs cig 'ong*/ de ma las thob pa'i thig le yin/ rdo rje nor bu nas thig le dkar po thigs gcig 'ong*/ de pha las thob pa'i thig le yin/ de ltar yang*/ lus can rnams ni 'pho ba'i tshe// bdud rtsi nyi ma gyen la 'dzeg /byang sems zla ba thur du 'bab// de tshe lus ni 'jig par 'gyur// zhes gsung ba yang 'di la dgongs pa yin/ bcos de ma red na dpe ci dang 'dra na/ da ci rta rgod de phur pa la ma btags na shad kyis 'gro ba bzhin/ thig le gnyis po de yan man du 'chugs nas kha chems kyang 'jog long mi yong ba yin/ des na rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs la mkhas par byed dgos pas/ de ltar thugs kyi dal du bzhag nas nyams su len par zhu gsungs// yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'di gnad shin tu che/ 'pho ba rang la yang*/ rigs mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa zhig yod na'ang*/ 'pho ba zhal gdams ma shin tu zab pa yin te/ de yang sngon rje mar pa lo tsā chen po de/ rngog gzhung pas gzhung gi ri bo ru spyan drangs nas chos zhus/ gnag med bdun cu tham pa 'jo zo btsun mo sgo khyi yan chad phul/ 'bri rgan mo zhig bzhag pa la/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ khyod 'bri rgan mo de mi 'bul ba ci yin gsungs/ 'di la g.yang yod pa yin zhus pas/ nga la yang sgom pas sangs rgyas pa'i gtum mo bya ba yod de/ khyod la bstan pa yin/ ma sgom par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag 'pho ba bya ba yod/ de g.yang yod pas khyod la mi ston gsung*/ gzod de nas 'bri rgan ma de yang phul zhabs tog dpag tu med pa mdzad pa dang*/ 'pho ba'i gdams ngag kyang gnang ba yin gsungs/ de yang 'di la sa bcad kyi dmigs pa lnga yin te/ dang po rlung ltas brtag pa dang gcig lus bcos te 'pho ba dang gnyis/ sems bcos te 'pho ba dang gsum/ tug tug gi dus gnad dang bzhi/

bla ma mtho bar bsgom pa dang lnga yin/ de la dang po rlung ltas brtag pa ni/ g.yul ngor mtshon gyis rmas pa'am/ rbab tu song ba'am/ mgo chag pa la sogs pa glo bur ba la 'di 'ong ba'i nges pa med/ 'o na gang la 'ong snyam na rang nyid zhag shas rab tu gnas lus shed chung*/ rang la rang yid mi ches pa zhig 'ong*/ de'i dus su dang po zhag 'ga'/ sna bug g.yas na mar rlung shar shar rgyu/ de rlung sems thams cad rtsa g.yas pa'i nang nas tshur ldog pa yin/ yang zhag 'ga' na sna bug g.yon na mar rlung shar shar rgyu/ de rlung sems thams cad rtsa g.yon pa'i nang nas tshur ldog pa'i rtags yin/ yang sna bug gnyis ka na mar rlung shar shar rgyu/ de rlung sems thams cad rtsa dbu ma'i nang du tshur ldog pa'i rtags yin/ de ltar byung na ltas ngan chen po'i rlung yin pas 'jig rten 'di blo lings kyis btang la/ skye ba gtan gyi so nam sgrub dgos pas/ gnyis pa lus bcos te 'pho ba seṅge'i nyal stabs byas te/ de yang seṅge'i nyal stabs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan mi'i seṅge sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa'i dus su/ 'khrul 'khor 'di ltar mdzad pas/ seṅge'i nyal stabs

ni mgo byang phyogs su bstan/ gzhog g.yas pa sa la phab/ rkang pa gnyis shad kyis brkyang*/ long bu'i steng du long bu 'ong bar bya/ lag pa g.yon pa brla'i steng na phyir brkyang*/ g.yas pa'i lag mthil 'gram pa la gtad/ zer ba yin/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs kyi 'khrul 'khor re la gnad du song bas/ ting nge 'dzin re la gnad du 'gro ba gshis yin/ 'khrul 'khor rgyal po dang 'dra/ ting nge 'dzin bran dang 'dra bgyi ba yin pas/ 'di'i dus su seṅge'i nyal stabs 'di shin tu zab pa yin/ gsum pa sems bcos te 'pho ba ni/ dkon mchog rten dang mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams/ sems bskyed lus yi dam gyi lhar wal gyis bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma shab kyis gsal gdab/ de yang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ mar sna spu mtshams su zug pa/ yar sna spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar zug pa/ tshangs bug skar khung ltar gsal ha re yod pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i mar sna rang gi shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ kha dog dmar po me stag lta bu zhig phyed rtsa dbu ma'i nang na hrib be chud nas yod par bsam/ spyi gtsug nas 'dom gang yan chod tsam gyi nam mkhar/ rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma blo gtod thub pa yod na de nyid bzhugs par bsam/ blo thub nges med na yi dam gyi lha bzhugs par bsam/ de nas yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus khams kyis ci lcogs su 'bul/ de nas las sbyor nam ran pa'i dus su/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ de/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar rgyangs kyis byon pas bla ma yi dam gang yin de'i thugs kar thim par bsgom/ de nas shes pa mar mi gzhug de ltar 'phos na rnam shes bla ma yi dam du 'pho bya ba yin shin tu zab pa lags/ bzhi pa tug tug gi dus gnad ni/ phyi dbugs bsdus/ nang dbugs ma chad pa'i skabs der/ rkang pa phyir 'gul ba zhig dang*/ mig gyen la log pa zhig 'ong*/ kha thang gis byed/ 'di la 'jig rten pa rnams kyis shi 'phras zer/

de'i dus su mi zhe sdang chung ba chos rgyus yod pa zhig sems la 'phrod pa zhig tshangs bug thad so na mar cung zad reg cing 'di na khyod kyi bla ma yi dam bzhugs zhes go gsed bya/ 'di'i dus su tshig drag po dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pa dang*/ tug tug kyang drag po byed du ma nyan/ zhe sdang skye dogs yod/ rten ma phyogs su 'gro 'dug mi bya byas na rnam shes 'og sgo na mar 'phos nas ngan song du 'gro ba yin/ de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan skabs der yan lag gi rlung thams cad rtsa dbu ma'i nang na tshur sdogs nas rlung sems thams cad dngul chu smyug ma'i nang blug pa ltar der 'dus nas yod pas/ nang gi shes pa sngar 'gyur mang pos gsal bas spyi bo na mar yang reg pa tsam gyis tshor nas rnam shes yar 'pho ba yin/ dus gnad kyi las sbyor ni dus der ran pa yin pas/ rang nyid kyis kyang rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba la sogs pa gdams ngag kyang skabs der dran par bya/ lnga pa bla ma mtho bar bsgom pa'i gnad ni/ rdo rje'i lus 'di 'byung ba lnga'i rlung lnga yod/ de rnams rlung dang bsdongs nas yar thon pas bla ma mtho ba'i gnad kyis nam mkha' la 'ja' kha dog lnga khra thib kyis yong*/ spyi bo na yar tsha chi li li rlangs pa thul gyis yong*/ des 'pho ba gsha' ma thebs pa'i rtags yin/ des na 'di la 'pho ba nags shod ma zhes kyang zer 'ja' tshon ma zhes kyang zer/ zhal gdams ma zhes kyang zer mdor na zhal gdams ma yin te rje nā ro pa nas da lta yan chad du gang zag gzhan gyi lhad ma zhugs pa/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa zhal nas zhal du gdams pa yin/ de yang 'chi nges pa'i dus ma gtogs pa byed mi btub/ de ltar byas na rang srog rang gis bcad pa'i nyes pa shin tu che ste/ de ltar yang*/ dus la bab na 'pho byas te// dus min lha rnams gsod par byed// lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni// nges par dmyal bar 'tshod par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

des na dus dang dus ma yin pa la sogs pa'i gnad la shin tu mkhas par byed dgos pa lags pas/ de ltar thugs kyi dal du bzhag nas nyams su len par zhu gsung*// // 759) ༄// rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba 'pho ba nag shod ma'i gdams pa// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gal che/ 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams su blang ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu/ sna tshogs padma dang*/ nyi ma zla ba'i gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ bla ma rin po che sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig gsal bar bsgom/ de nas rang gi gsang gnas su/ rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lo bcu drug lon pa/ phyag g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ zhabs brkyang skum du bzhugs pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang du bzhugs pa/ sku zag pa med pa bde ba chen po'i nyams can gyis gar stabs su glog glog bzhugs pa'i thugs kar thig le dmar po sran ma'i ga'u tsam zhig bsam/ yi dam lha'i thugs ka nas thig le dkar po sran ma'i ga'u tsam zhig bsam/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes tshar gcig brjod pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i thig le sran ma'i ga'u tsam de dang*/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i thig le dmar po sran ma'i ga'u tsam gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gcig tu 'dres nas dkar la dmar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur nas/ rang yi dam lhar bsgom pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor chos skor du bskor ba lan gsum du bskor nas/ yang snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor g.yas skor lan gsum du bskor/ de nas yang mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor lan gsum du bskor/

de nas spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor lan gsum du bskor nas/ spyi bo'i gtsug gi khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ bla ma rin po che'i sku mtshon gang pa zhig bzhugs pa'i thugs kar/ hig gsum gyis phul nas thim pas/ rang dang bla ma gnyis su med par tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par gsungs// // 760) ༄// rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig gi gdams ngag/ rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig gi gdams ngag 'di la snang ba 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad rlung sems kyi rten 'brel yin/ de la rtsa ba'i chings rnam pa gsum ni/ de la ngan rtog yid la byed dus rlung bzung ba ni/ rtsa nang du 'phel bas sdug bsngal skye zhing gegs skyon sna tshogs 'ong*/ bzang rtog yid la byed dus rlung bzung na yon tan sna tshogs 'byung*/ yid byed yid smon thams cad dang bral bas rlung gnad du chud na/ skad gcig gis phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa 'char zhing*/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o// de la rgyas par bshad na/ bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rags pa tsam du phye na ngan rtog nyon mongs dug lnga dang*/ bdud bzhi'i rgyu tshul shes dgos/ de la zhe sdang skyes dus su/ rlung phyir 'bud ma shes na pho gdon gyi gnod pa dang*/ nad tshad gzer lta bu dang*/ bu slob 'khrug pa dang gris shi ba dang*/ me lum la sogs pa sna tshogs 'byung*/ 'dod chags phyir 'bud ma shes na/ mo gdon gyi gnod pa 'byung*/ nad grang ba 'jug sdom pa mi thub/ 'khor sdom shor dang khyim btsun 'ong*/ gti mug phyir 'bud ma shes na/ sa gdon gyi gnod pa dang*/ bad kan dang mdze nad la sogs pa 'ong*/ nga rgyal la phyir 'bud ma shes na/ rgyal 'gong gdon/ smyo 'bog can 'ong*/ 'dug mi tshugs/ rang dang 'khor ngan par 'gro/ phrag dog phyir 'bud ma shes na/ rbod gdon gdon/ byad kha dal yams 'ong*/ 'khor gzhan gyi dbang du 'gro/ bdud bzhi'i gnas tshul ni/

lha'i bu'i bdud rtsa'i rgyud la gnas/ nam langs kar rgyu/ rgyal 'gong dang bsdongs/ rtags shes pa yang mtho ba dang*/ 'gro snying 'dod pa 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ rtsa mig thams cad du bla ma bsgom/ phung po'i bdud sha rus la gnas/ nyin phyed rgyu/ sa bdag dang bsdongs/ rtags shes pa gnyid pa khams nyob pa 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ bla ma lte bar bsgom/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud khu khrag la gnas/ dgong kha rgyu/ mo gdon dang sdongs/ rtags snying mi dga' ba 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ lte bar bla ma bsgom/ 'chi bdag gi bdud rlung la gnas/ nam phyed rgyu/ sbad 'dre dang sdongs/ rtags bred sngangs dang snying 'khrug 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ snying gar bla ma bsgom/ nad gdon gyi gegs des 'gre'o// bzang rtog gi bye brag la/ mos gus snying rje zhen log bskyed rdzogs bde gsal mi rtog pa skye dus/ rlung phyir bus na de dag gi nus pa nyams zhing*/ dngos grub yal bas rlung sems nang du sdud dgos/ mos gus skye dus rlung phyir bus na/ bla mas thugs la mi 'dog snying rje skye dus rlung phyir bus na/ sems can gyi 'gro don mi 'grub/ zhen log skye dus rlung phyir bus na zas nor mi 'du/ bskyed rim sgom dus rlung phyir bus na yi dam mi 'grub/ bsngags bzlas dus rlung phyir bus na/ nus pa mi 'byung*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa skye dus rlung phyir bus na/ ting nge 'dzin mi skye/ de dag gi dus su rlung sems gnad du bsdu ba la/ dbang bskur gsum dang*/ bsre ba bskor gsum lta bu nyams su len dgos pa yin/ de dag log pa rlung sems kyi rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyams len shes dgos par bya'o// yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral ba ni/ rlung sems phyag rgya chen po dang*/ rgyun chad med par bskor ba'o// mdor na rlung sems ngan pa thams cad phyir 'bud/

bzang po thams cad nang du bsdu/ thams cad dbyer med ro gcig pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// chos rje rin po che'i gdams ngag zab mo lags so// // 761) ༄// zab chos las rten 'brel chu yi sbyor ba'i man ngag// bla ma rin chen dpal la 'dud// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po yi// zhal gyi gdams pa las byung ba'i// rten 'brel chu yi sbyor ba bshad// tsha ba smin pa'i dus tshod ni// grang shul g.ya' ba chag pa dang*// mgo bo na zhing lci ba dang*// lce skya gzhung ni ser nag gyur// de sogs smin pa'i rtags sogs tshe// 'di nyid gtong ba'i dus yin no// gzhan yang tsha ba bye snyoms dang*// shes pa 'khrul zhing bcal bcol smra// de yi dus su mchog tu bshad// de la chu yi rnam dbye ni// ba tshwa can dang ko mo sogs// 'khyil chu cul pa ma yin zhing*// 'bab chu drag po'i rgyun las ni// skar ma ma gyes gong dag tu// khye'u bu mo gtsang ma 'am// tshul khrims ldan pa'i rigs can sogs// nag po min pa'i snod du blangs// nad pa'i mdun du bzhag byas nas// lam gtong sems bskyed sngon btang nas// rang dang nad pa yi dam du// gsal zhing bla ma snying gar bsgom// chu de bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang*// skad cig padma zla ba'i steng*// 'phags pa thugs rje chen por bskyed// ye shes spyan drangs bstim zhing slar// dbang skur rgyas gdab spyi dang mthun// thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyi mthar// yi ge drug pa g.yas bskor bsam// de la dmigs te brgya rtsa sogs// ci nus bzlas la bdud rtsi'i rgyun// sku gang bde ba chen por zhu// snod kyi chu dang dbyer med gyur// skyog gam gzar bus lan gsum 'phyar// de nyin nad pas g.yog tshad du// ci mang byugs la gos mang pos// sbyig gos kyi mnan pa ste ser bu ma shor bar// mgo bo btums te nyal bar bya// lus las rngul ni 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltar gzhon na lan mang bya// rgan na grangs gcig langs srid pas// tshod dang sbyar la gtang bar bya// rjes su mar gsar btab pa yi// thug pa bza' ba la sogs ni// ri thang mtshams kyi spyod lam bsten// rten 'brel chu yi sbyor ba 'di// ga bur gtong ba'i dod ma yin// 'dis mtshon dus gsum gang yod dge// 'gro kun dug lnga'i nad bral nas// bde chen gdod ma'i gnas lugs mchog

/yon tan 'phrin las mngon gyur shog/ // 762) ༄// zab chos kyi tshig don zab mo'i tho yig/ na mo ratna gu ru/ rje'i zhal nas/ brgyud pa la brgyud pa'i chos dang*/ brgyud pa'i grub mtha' dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar gsum yin gsung*/ dang po ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ gnyis pa ni/ snang ba rang sems dang*/ dge ba gshis kyi dge la/ mi dge ba gshis kyi mi dge ba la sogs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ sku'i rnam thar tshul khrims rin po che/ gsung gi rnam thar dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras gtan la 'bebs pa/ thugs kyi rnam thar byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin to// de la 'ga' zhig mtshan thos pa tsam gyis grol bar gyur la// la la zhal mthong ba tsam gyis grol bar gyur/ dbang po tha ma ni/ chos 'khor gsum du gsungs pas grol te/ de yang sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi/ chos kyi phung po 'am sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad rten gyi gang zag gcig gi khrid kyi rim par bzhed pa'o// de dag kyang chos 'khor drug tu 'dus te/ dang po grub mtha' thams cad gtan la 'bebs shing thos bsam gyis smin grol byed pa bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pa bstan bcos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang gcig /go ba tsam gyis grub mtha' ngan pa thams cad 'joms par byed cing smin grol byed pa tshogs chos kyi 'khor lo dang gnyis/ bsgoms pas bag chags thams cad smin grol byed pa khrid chos kyi 'khor lo dang gsum/ gsang sngags kyi gnad thun mong ma yin pa shes pas smin grol du byed pa zab chos kyi 'khor lo dang bzhi/ tshig nyung la don 'dril bas smin grol byed pa las chos kyi 'khor lo dang lnga/ lam gyi skyon thams cad sel bas smin grol byed pa dmigs pa gegs sel gyi 'khor lo dang drug go// de la dang po ni/ thugs bskyed chen mo/

grub mtha' thams cad gtan la 'bebs pa blo gros 'jug pa/ chos 'khor gsum gtan la 'bebs pa 'ong ge ma/ bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pa zhus len gyi skor/ rnam rtog shan 'byed pa dang sa dang lam gyi sa mtshams 'byed pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa tshigs bcad ma la sogs pa'o// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid de don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon rung ma byon rung*/ dge sdig gnyis las 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis 'byung ba'i gshis de kun rdzob bden pa yin/ de yang sems nyid skye ba med pa la rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam rtog thol gyis skye ba de la zer ro// de la spyir 'khor 'das gnyis sam/ dge sdig gnyis su babs kyis gnas pa de la/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon nas babs de mkhyen nas dgag sgrub tu gsungs pa 'dul ba'i sde snod chos 'khor dang po'o// 'khor 'das thams cad gdod ma nas stong nyid 'ba' zhig tu gtan la 'bebs pa mdo sde'i sde snod 'khor lo bar pa'o// theg pa sna tshogs pa thams cad theg pa gcig tu ston cing dkon mchog gsum rgyun mi chad par gtan la 'bebs pa mngon pa'i sde snod te 'khor lo tha ma'o// de ltar sangs rgyas kyis rten 'brel 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pa ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi// gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// zhes pas/ rten 'brel de la de bzhin gshegs pas mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i rten 'brel du ming btags/ rje sgam po pas lhan cig skyes pa'i chos skur ming btags/ rje phag mo gru pa yab sras kyis rang byung lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes su ming btags/

de la rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam rtog tu thol gyis skyes pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'di las 'di 'byung gi rten 'brel du ming btags/ rje sgam po bas snang ba chos sku'i 'od du ming btags/ rje phag mo gru pas/ snang ba rang sems su ming btags/ chos rje rin po ches skad gcig ma bsam pa'i rang gzugs dang*/ lus 'pho ba bsam pa'i rang gzugs la sogs par ming btags/ de thams cad rten 'brel 'ba' zhig go// de yang gcig tu gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bcu gnyis su gsungs pa ste/ de dag kyang mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung dang*/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'brel rnams gcig pa yin/ rgyu 'bras zhes kyang bya/ rten 'brel zhes kyang bya ste/ de gnyis gcig /sgyu ma lta bu/ nam mkha' lta bu/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras dang mthong chos la sogs pa gsum mo// de la zab rgyas/ thabs shes/ tshul ting*/ tshogs gnyis/ sems gnyis/ bden gnyis te/ de rnams la lung gtam rgyud dang bcas pas smin cing grol bar byed pa'i lam ston pa tshogs chos kyi 'khor lo'o// gsum pa don khrid kyi skor la gnyis/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang 'dra ba phyag rgya chen po'i khrid dang*/ thabs lam gyi khrid do// dang po la lhan cig skyes sbyor/ thun 'jog a ro ma/ thog 'bab la sogs rnams so// gnyis pa la smin byed dbang gis chos kyi sgo phye nas/ grol byed skyed rdzogs gnyis sgom pa ste/ sdig pa dag byed yi ge brgya pa'i/ tshogs rdzogs byed maṇḍal gyi/ sgom skyed byed phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi/ skyes pa brtan byed nyams lha'i/ brtan pa bogs 'don mos gus kyis mthar phyin par byed pa ngo sprod kyi/ ngo bo la go ba skye bar byed pa mnyam bzhag gi khrid do// gnyis pa thabs lam dngos la/ ka dpe ma/ 'khor lo spangs pa'i grangs 'dzin ma/

ka med lding khang ma/ gnad bsdus phreng ba ma la sogs pa'o// sngon du 'gro ba byams snying rje'i khrid/ gnad la go ba skye ba 'khrul 'khor gyi/ sgom sran can sangs rgya ba la gtum mo'i/ mos gus can sangs rgya ba 'od gsal gyi/ dran pa can sangs rgya ba sgyu lus kyi/ 'dun pa can sangs rgya ba rmi lam gyi/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa 'pho ba'i/ gdam ngag can sangs rgya ba bar do'i/ chos drug rnying ma'i bogs 'don/ gsar ma'i skyon sel/ yon tan bskyed pa sum khrid kyi/ 'khor lo bzhi ma bla ma'i/ rang lus lha skur ngo sprod pa skyed rim kyi/ skra dkar gnyer ma med cing stobs bskyed pa thig le'i/ lus bde ba 'grub pa bsod snyoms pa'i/ lus 'jig pa med pa tshe dpag med kyi/ sems gnas par byed pa bsam gtan thun 'jog gi/ 'phrin las rgyun chad med par byed pa byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi khrid do// de rnams don khrid chos kyi 'khor lo ste gsum pa'o/ bzhi pa gsang sngags kyi gnad thun mong ma yin pa shes pas smin cing grol ba byed pa zab chos kyi 'khor lo la/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa skyon yon tan du bsgyur ba bcu chos kyi zab chos/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa skyon yon tan du bsgyur ba la sum chos kyi zab chos/ theg pa thams cad kyi mthil ston cing rgyu la mkhas pas skyon yon tan tu bsgyur nas 'bras bu skyon med du 'pho ba 'khor lo ma'i zab chos/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs go bas sangs rgyas rang las rnyed pa 'khor lo lnga ma'i zab chos/ gsang sngags kyi mthil go bas shes bya'i sgrib pa spong ba rtsa rlung ma'i zab chos/ 'phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba 'khor lo bzhi'i de nyid kyi zab chos/ chos rnams gcig tu 'khyer ba chos drug spyi chings kyi zab chos/ lus sems snang ba gsum gyi gshis rtogs pas sangs rgya ba gshis ngo sprod kyi zab chos/

rten 'brel dus la mkhas pa rlung ltas brtag pa'i zab chos/ dus gnad la mkhas pa nyi zla gzas 'dzin gyi zab chos/ thos pas the tshom gcod pa kun gzhi ngo sprod kyi zab chos/ dbang lnga sems nyid du ngo sprod pa la phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus kyi zab chos/ dge sdig lung ma bstan mtshams 'byed pa lung ma bstan ngos 'dzin gyi zab chos/ spyir sum chos gcig po la yang*/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs par grags pas/ gang zag re'i khams rgyud dang bstun nas/ zab chos kyang mtha' med do// lnga pa tshig nyung la don 'dril ba gdams ngag gi bcud bsdus pa las chos kyi skor la/ 'khrul 'khor gsum la rten nas yon tan bskyed pa'i gdams ngag /rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams kyi gdams ngag /bar chad dngos grub tu bsgyur ba nyams gsum gyi gdams ngag /gsang sngags nyams su len pa g.yon pa kun spyod kyi gdams ngag /rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba bslu ba/ ku su lu'i tshogs bsog gi man ngag tshogs 'khor bdud rtsir sgyur ba'i/ pha rgyud kyi snying lta bu sems snang ba gsum gyi/ ma rgyud kyi snying lta bu/ 'dod chags chos kyi sbas pa/ yab la brten nas gdon gegs tshar gcod/ yum la brten nas dbang du bsdu ba'i/ yi dam la brten nas dbab bzlog dgram pa'i/ sngags btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa'i/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa drag po sbyor sgrol gyi/ rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba dar mdud ma'i/ rnal 'byor gcig gis kun bsrung ba bsrung 'khor zhal gdams ma'i/ lho phyogs zlog byed dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro'i/ skad cig ma rten 'brel gyi/ yams nad zlog pa yi ge gsum gyi bsrung ba'i/ rdo rje'i lus la tshe srung bsrung ba'i/ rnal 'byor pa'i 'chi ltas zlog pa rta btod phur la btod pa'i/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rgya 'grol ba a cig pad dkar gyi/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs dgu phrugs su ston pa'i/ chos kyi rtsa ba gser chos kyi/
don grub lugs kyi/ rgya gar gangs kyi dpa' bo'i/ 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod kyi/ zhus so// //

763) ༄// phyag chen sngon 'gro'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs pa// sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du yi ge brgya pa dang maṇḍal gyi bsgom bzlas bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ bsnyen pa'i maṇḍal gang yang 'di ltar bya ste/ rab rin po che'i maṇḍal/ 'bring sa dang shing gi maṇḍal bya ste/ de yang rin po che yin na sor bzhi yan chad kyang 'bul du rung*/ sa dang shing gi yin na ni khru gang bas chung ba 'bul du mi nyan pa yin gsung*/ de lta bu'i maṇḍal gang yin yang dri ma la sogs pa med pa legs par phyi/ dri ma dang nag tshag la sogs pa'i skyon med pa gal che/ rang gi sems la skyon yod na maṇḍal la skyon yong ba rten 'brel yin/ 'di shin tu gnad zab pa yin pas/ gnad 'di go dgos/ maṇḍal 'bul ba'i dus su rgyan lag pa g.yas su 'dzin/ g.yon pas maṇḍal bzung ste legs par phyi/ rgyan med par phyis na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams stong par skye ba'i skyon yod pa yin/ de nas rgyan bkod de/ 'di la rin po che'i bzhed kyis mtha' mar song na yul mtha' 'khob tu skye/ dbus su nye drags na zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mi go ba'i skyon yod pas nye ring ran par 'god par bya/ de yang maṇḍal 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par sbyong ba yin pas/ rgyu rin po che la sogs pa gal che bar gda'/ sngon chos kyi rje e chung na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rdo leb kyi maṇḍal gcig las 'bul rgyu ma rnyed gsung nas/ phyis thel du byon pa'i dus su/ nga la pha ri tshu ri 'di la thang 'di tsam gcig yod pa la/ thel mdo 'di la dgon pa 'debs dgos par byung ba/ de'i dus su maṇḍal cig 'bul rgyu ma rnyed pas byung ba yin gsung*/ maṇḍal yang rgyu dang dbyibs phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ tshom bu lnga dgod par bya/

dbus kyi tshom bu de/ seṅge brgyad kyi khri steng na sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng na sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rang gi bla ma dam pa bzhugs par bsam/ sku'i mdun du tshom bu gcig bkod/ yi dam gyi lha bzhugs par bsam/ sku'i g.yas su tshom bu gcig bkod/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog bzhugs par bsam/ sku'i rgyab tu tshom bu gcig bkod/ chos dkon mchog bzhugs par bsam/ sku'i g.yon du tshom bu gcig bkod/ dge 'dun dkon mchog bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar bla ma yi dam jo bo dkon mchog gsum rang gi mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsam/ de la rang gi lus longs spyod kha rje dang dbang thang mthu dang nus pa thams cad ltos pa med par yid kyis 'bul/ bdag 'dzin btang na rtogs pa skye gsung bas/ bdag 'dzin thong pa gal shin tu che/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni ngag tu/ bla ma dam pa rnams bdag gi lus yongs su bzhes su gsol/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams bdag gi lus yongs su bzhes su gsol/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum po bdag gi lus yongs su bzhes su gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum mam lnga'i bar du gdab/ de nas yang bla ma dam pa rnams bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs kyis bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ lha 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum pos bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan lnga'am bdun gyi bar du gdab/ de ltar bla ma yi dam lha jo bo dkon mchog gsum maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhugs la/ de rang gis yid kyis spyan drangs nas spyi bo nas mar bstim/ de nas rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar bsnams pa/

g.yon dril bu dku la brten pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs phyed pa'i dkyil krung du bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong rang nyid tshangs pa'i bu ga na mar reg ge bzhugs par bsam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i thugs ka na gdan gcig rtsegs kyi steng na/ hūm̐ḥdakar po dngul chu'i mdog lta bu zhig bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ḥde las yar mar ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar na ra ra byon nas zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi sha dang sen mo'i bar na mar byon nas/ rang gi spyi bo na mar byon par bsam/ des tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan gyi sdig pa sgrib pa thams cad nag nu ru ru ded nas dri chen dri chu'i lam dang*/ sor mo bcu'i bar na mar ded par bsam/ de la shes pa ma yengs par gtad la dmigs pa bzung*/ de nas ngag tu yi ge brgya pa ci nus bgrang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas 'di la rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba gnyis/ tha ma zla ba gcig gi bar la bzlas bsgom nan chags che bar byas pas/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung*/ de'i dus su phyag rgya chen po'i sgom btab pas/ thebs pa la tshegs med pa yin/ nan chags shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu// //yang phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom gcig bstan par bya ste/ rkang pa rdo rje'i dkyil krung legs par bya/ sgal tshigs gser gyi dong tse ltar bsrang*/ mgrin pa'i dbyibs dgu tsam bya/ mig sna rtser dbab/ lce'i rtse mo ya skan la reg tsam bya/ de nas phyag g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag /mtheb chen gnyis po nang du bkug /lte ba'i 'og gnyer po che'i ltag tu lus la lhan gyis glod pa yin/ 'khrul 'khor de ltar du legs par byas pas/ ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba yin/ de yang 'am bus ji ltar yod pa bzhin du bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/

de'i ched du bsgom pa 'di bsgom snyam du bsam/ lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin par wal gyis bsgom/ khong pa'i nang thams cad gtsang la dwangs pa khru ma phus btab pa bzhin du bsam/ stong ra 'di gtsang bar bsgoms pas/ dmigs pa gang bsgoms kyang yul gsal ba'i dgos pa yod pa yin/ snying gi dbus drang po der bla ma dam pa dran par bya/ snying gi rtse mo de babs kyis thur la bstan pa yin/ bla ma dam pa bsgom pa'i dus su snying gi rtse mo gyen la bstan la/ snying de gur dkar gyi tshul du bsam/ de'i nang du bla ma dam pa rin po che dran par mdzod/ de nas sems ma bcos par bzhag mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pa skyes par song na/ de la sems ma bcos pa bgyi ba/ mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang yang ma skyes pa'i dus kyi shes pa gcig 'byung*/ byung ba de ngo shes par byas nas 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags ste/ de yang yod par bsgom na bcos ma/ med par bsgom na bcos ma/ dbus su bsgom na bcos ma gsung bas/ ma bcos pa'i dus kyi shes pa 'di kho na skyong ba lags/ 'di la ci gnas gnas kyi bar du skyong*/ 'di las langs pa'i dus su dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba re mdzad/ de ltar lan gsum btab pas/ bla ma la byin brlabs yod na slob ma'i rgyud la 'jug pa yin/ 'di phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan bgyi ba lags pas/ 'di la gsung tshig rnam pa lnga bdog sems bskyed pa dang*/ lus yi dam lhar bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa snying gi dbus su bsgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po la sems ma bcos par 'jog pa dang*/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba byed pa dang lnga po de la phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gsungs pa lags pas/ dus rgyun chad med par de kho na bzhin du skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'chag pa dang nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su yang*/

mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang yang yid la mi byed/ ma skyes pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ de la mtho ba dang dma' ba dang bzang ba dang ngan pa la sogs pa gang yang yid la mi byed par 'di kho na bzhin skyong ba lags/ des na gang yang yid la mi byed pa des ni/ chos thams cad yid la byed pa'o// bgyi ba gsung*/ gzhan yang yid la mi byed pas ni khams gsum po gang du'ang 'dre bar mi 'gyur ro bgyi ba gsungs pas/ 'di kho na bzhin du nyams su len par zhu 'tshal/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su'ang*/ ma yengs par byas nas skyong ba lags/ de la mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pa ma skyes pa'i shes pa 'di la/ sems ma bcos pa chos kyi sku bgyi ba gsungs pa yin pas/ 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ 'di skyong bar byed pa la sgrim glod gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral bar byas nas skyong bar byed pa yin/ de la bram ze skud pa 'khal ba bzhin/ so ma ma bcos lhug par zhog gsungs pas/ bram ze'i skud pa de grims thal na 'jur mdud du song nas chad nas yong*/ glod thal na 'byung nas yong*/ des na grims glod gnyis ka'i mtha' dang bral bar byas pa'i dus su bzo nyan pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dir shes pa sgrims thal na dge sbyor gnad du mi 'gro nas rtog pa mang du 'phro nas 'ong*/ glod thal bar song na shes pa g.yas g.yon du 'phyo nas 'ong*/ des na sgrim glod gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral bar byas nas/ ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du bskyangs pas gnad du 'gro ba la tshegs med pa yin pas/ de ltar skyong bar zhu/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'chag pa dang nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su yang skyong ba yin/ de la sems ma bcos na bde/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs bgyi ba gsungs pas/ ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ de la bcos par song na 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad bgyi ba mthong bar mi 'gyur ba yin/

des na bcos ma'i stobs kyis 'phags lam mthong mi 'gyur// ces gsungs/ sems ma bcos pa bgyi ba 'di kho na bzhin du skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'chag pa dang nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su yang skyong ba lags/ 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba la brtson 'grus chen po bgyi ba lags pas/ de la brtson 'grus chen po'i go cha ni// dran pa rgyun chad med pa yin// bgyi ba gsungs pas/ des na dge sbyor 'di la dran pa rgyun chad med par skyong ba dang*/ nyams su len par zhu 'tshal/ 'di kho na bzhin du skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ 'gro ba dang 'chag pa nyal ba 'dug pa'i dus su yang skyong bar byed pa la dran pa ma yengs par skyong ba lags/ des na/ dran pa yengs med ma shes na// mi bsgom pa la bya thabs med// bgyi ba gsungs pas/ dge sbyor 'di dran pa yengs pa med par skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'chag pa nyal ba 'dug pa spyod lam rnam pa bzhi gang gi dus su yang bskyangs pas goms nas 'ong ba lags pas/ des na bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin// goms pas lta ba mchog tu byed// bgyi ba gsung*// gzhan yang bsgom rgyu med kyang goms rgyu yod bgyi ba gsungs pas/ 'gro ba dang 'chag pa nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su yang 'di kho na bzhin du goms su bcug pas/ goms pa mthar phyin nas gnad du 'gro ba la tshegs med pa yin/ 'di kho na bzhin du nyams su len par zhu/ 'di kho na bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'chag pa nyal ba 'dug pa gang gi dus su yang mtho dman la sogs pa bsam mno gang yang mi byed par ji lta ba bzhin du skyong ba lags/ des na mtho dman bsam mno ma byas na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan 'char// bgyi ba gsungs pas/ 'di kho na bzhin du nyams su blangs pas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus pa thams cad rgyud la skye ba la tshegs med pas 'di kho na bzhin du nyams su len par zhu 'tshal/

'di yi skabs su bogs 'don gnang bar gda'/ 'di la thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don pa dang*/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don pa rnam pa gnyis yin/ de yang sngon chos kyi rje phag mo gru na bzhugs pa'i dus su dpal chen po chos kyi ye shes nye gnas mdzad pa yin par gda'/ khong shing thu ba dang*/ phye 'thag pa chu len pa la sogs pa las khur shin tu che bar byung bas/ shes pa dub pa dang*/ nga'i lto skal gyi phyed kyis mi gcig gso bar zhu zhus pa lags par gda'/ de'i dus su chos kyi rje'i dgongs pa la/ da 'di la dge sbyor gcig 'debs ran nas 'dug snyam du dgongs nas/ da sang phyin chad nas khyed rang rnams kyang bya ba byed pa dge sbyor 'di'i bogs 'don du bsgoms nas/ dge sbyor sems ma bcos pa'i 'di kho na bzhin du skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas kyang*/ 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan// gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med// ces gsungs pas/ gnya' shing gang po de 'dom gang tshun chad kyi sa gzhi de mig gis non par byed nas nyams su blangs pas gnad du 'gro ba la tshegs med/ sems 'khrul pa zhes bya ba mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pas bslad pa'i dus kyi shes pa de la gsungs pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gi dus su yang*/ de kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba re mdzad par zhu/ 'di bogs 'don thon chos lags pas spyil por ji ltar bsgom pa bzhin du 'dir yang skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ snying gi dbus drang po der bla ma rin po che dran tsam bya/ de la sems ma bcos par bzhag sems ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba la rtog pa snga ma'i rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da ltar ba yid la mi byed nas/ sems ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/

'di la phyag rgya chen po zhes gsung*/ chos kyi sku zhes gsung*/ tha mal pa'i shes pa zhes gsung*/ de la chos rje sgam po ba'i zhal nas kyang a pho nga tha mal shes pa skyong gsungs pas/ tha mal gyi dus su de ltar gnas pa de ngo mi shes/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas kyang*/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan ste rtogs// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang du bltas kyang de de nyid// de ring nyid du mgon po nga ni 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la yang 'dri bar mi bgyi 'o// bgyi ba gsung*/ gdod nas skye ba med pa 'di ltar du gnas pa la bla ma dam pas ngo sprad/ rang nyid kyi mngon du gyur nas/ sems skye ba med pa'i phyag rgya chen por shes pas/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcur bltas par song yang*/ phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig tu 'ong ba yin/ des na yul shes pas mi 'dzin pa lags/ mdun gyi gtor sder 'di la gzigs par zhu/ rang nyid kyi shes pa gtor sder la phyir mi 'dzin/ gtor sder gyi shes pa phyir mi 'dzin/ gtor sder gyi rjes su shes pa mi 'brang*/ gtor sder bkag pas mi kheg sems ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ sa gzhi dang ka ba la sogs pa phyi rol gyi yul gang byung yang*/ yul de dag gi steng du shes pa phyir mi 'dzin/ yul gyi shes pa yar mi 'dzin/ yul de dag gi rjes su shes pa mi 'brang*/ yul bkag pas mi khegs/ sna bar bsgo ba ma lags pa/ sems ma bcos pa 'di kho na bzhin du skyong ba lags/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ shes pa yul du mi spro te// yul ni sgro btags yin pa'i phyir// bzang ngan phye ba ma gtogs pa// don dam yul rang grub pa med// gsungs pas/ des na/ slob dpon tog tse pa'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog

/gsungs pas/ tha mal pa'i dus su yang 'di kho na bzhin du gnas pa yin/ da ltar gyi dus kyi shes pa mtho dman bzang ngan gyi rtog pas ma phye ba 'dis mi phan/ des na zin par mdzod/ shes par byas nas skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ des ni phyag rgya chen po'i khrid tshar ba lags/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid 'di gong du ma byas par song na phyin chad thabs lam zab mo nyams su len pa la nyams mthug po skyes nas phyag rgya chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa sgrib pa'i dogs yod pa yin/ gzhan yang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa tshan chen po skyes nas/ tshangs par spyod pa'i bar du gcod pa'i dogs yod pa yin/ des na thabs lam zab mo nyams su len pa la snod dang ldan par byed pa gal che/ de yang seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de// gser snod dngul snod ma lags pa// snod ngan phal du blugs gyur na// snod kyang 'chag la 'o ma'ang 'bo// de bzhin gsang sngags thabs lam 'di// slob ma snod ldan ma lags pa// snod ngan rnams la byin gyur na// dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ snod dang ldan pa gal shin tu che/ gong du phyag rgya chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa ngo sprad pa de gser gyi snod lta bu lags/ de'i steng du dngul gyi snod lta bu ni/ bdag cag thams cad la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod par byed pas gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje zhag lnga re nan chags shin tu che bar bsgom/ yang gnod byed kyis gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems zhag lnga'i bar du bsgom ste/ de ltar byams pa dang snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la zhag lnga'i bar du bsgom pa ni khrid thebs re re'i dod po yang yin/ thabs lam gyi sngon 'gro yang yin pas nan chags shin tu che bar sgom par zhu 'tshal//

764) ༄// gdams ngag thabs lam chos drug gi khrid// na mo ratna gu ru/ sku bzhi'i ngo bo ye shes lnga yi bdag /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus gcig pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdo rje 'chang chen thob pa'i thabs// bla ma'i gsung las zur tsam bri// yang 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa gsung ba lags pas/ rkang pa rdo rje'i dkyil krung bca'/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya chen po'i dus su bstan pa bzhin du bya/ khong pa'i nang thams cad gtsang la dwangs par bsam/ sems dmigs pa med pa dang dmigs pa gang yang mi bsgom pa yin/ 'di'i dus su ci yang mi bsgom pa yin te bka' rgya yin/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor legs par byas nas/ ci gnas gnas kyi bar du sdod/ 'di la ldang ba'i dus su dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba re bya/ lha tho tho re snyan bshal gyi sku mkhar gyi steng du shel gyi mchod rten khru gang ba gcig dang*/ dpang skong phyag rgya gcig dang*/ mu dra'i phyag rgya slang nga tsam gcig dang gsum byon pa yin par gda'/ de yang mu dra'i phyag rgya slang nga tsam de rang gi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya 'di mtshon pa'i brdar byon pa yin pas/ 'khrul 'khor de kho na bzhin du bcas legs par byas nas skyong bar zhu 'tshal/ 'di la tsog pu'i 'khrul 'khor gsung ba lags pas slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*/ birwa pa gnyis po dkyil krung 'ba' zhig yin gsung*/ rje btsun chen po mi las kyang*/ dkyil krung la brten nas/ gtum mo zla ba drug gi bar du bsgoms pas/ drod mthe bong gang las cher ma song ba lags par gda'/ phyis yab yul du byon nas nye du gnyen 'brel gang yang mi gda'/ khang thog tu rtsa skyes/ zhing la 'jag ma 'phyur nas nyams shin tu mi dga' bar gda' skad/ yul zhen chags gcad pa'i phyir khang thog tu zhag gsum bsgoms kyang drod cher ma song ba lags par gda'/
