/blo bral yid la byar med pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zhes gsungs/ gsum pa rjes su nyams myong skyong lugs ni/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pas blo sna thung sbud de ba'i ngang la bla ma sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyed nas/ gsol ba dung dung pa btab cing shes pa rang lugs su lhod nas ma yengs pa'i ngang la bzhag pas/ gsal la rtog pa med pa'i sing nge ye re rjen lhang nge ba 'ong*/ de spyod lam rnam bzhi mthar thon pa zhig dgos/ de la brtan pa thob pa goms 'dris kyis gzer bya ba ma yengs par yun ring du skyong dgos/ bsgom skyes bdag po med par ni// nor bu rin chen 'dam gseb shor// rgyal po 'bangs su babs pa bzhin// seng ge khyi yi zla la shor// des na zhen log bdag po dgos/ zhes gsungs pas// zhen log bsgom gyi rkang pa bya/ 'chi ba snying la lhan bzhag /tshe 'dir blo yis rgyang btang*/ mos gus bsgom gyi mgo bya ba/ bla ma la mos gus dung dung pa bya zhing bsgom pa'i skabs gsal stong sing nge ye re ba'i ngang nas phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad ngos zin par byas pas rang bzhin med par 'gro ste/ grub thob gling chen gongs kyis/ rtsi'i rgyal pos 'bru rnams bcud du bsgyur ba ltar// nyams myong rtsi yis snang srid bde chen sor gnas pa// gang shar gang mthong ba de skye med spros dang bral// 'di la ngos bzung med pas stong tsam mi dgos gsungs// de la nyams kyi mtho dman ni sna tshogs su 'ong ste/ res gsal stong du rjen lhang lhang ba nges shes dang bcas pa 'ong*/ res ni mun ne 'thibs se thom me thom mer 'ong*/ nga'i bsgom bcug song ngam snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ res ni ngos ma zin sna tshogs su 'phro yin tshig pa za 'khrug 'khrugs pa'ang 'ong ste/ de rnams nyams kyi mtho dman yin pas dgag sgrub mi byed par byung rgyal du skyong ba yin ste/ shan ti pas/ gnas na ma zhen skyo na thong*// gnyer kha ma byed yan du chug

/ched du gang 'dzin 'khrul ba yin// gzings las 'phur ba'i bya rog ltos// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas na gnas pa'i ngang la zhog /ched du gnyer nas spro mi dgos// 'gyus na gang 'gyu tshad ngos zin par bya// ched du gnyer nas gnas su 'jug mi dgos// bying na bla ma la gsol ba btab pa yin rig pa ngar bskyed yin/ bsgom pas bying ba rang sar dag nas 'gro/ rgod na de ka la ched du gtad yin/ bsgoms pas rgod par rang sa grol nas gsal stong du yer yer 'ong*/ de ltar bde sdug gi rkyen snang sna tshogs la dran pas zin par byas pas rang dag rang grol la 'gro ste/ sgo drug mtshan ma ci skyes kyang*// rang byung rang zhi rang dgar bzhag /de bzhin nyid kyis zin pas na// dug gsum dug lngas gnod mi nus// de bzhin nyid kyis ma zin na// lam gyi phyogs rnams kun spyad kyang*// gnas skabs bde 'gro nges 'byung gi// go 'phang dam par ga la 'gyur// gang shes nyon mongs rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhir ma yengs pa'i dran pa yud de ba zhig bya dgos te/ bram ze chen pos/ rang gi de nyid rang gis mtshon te ltos// ma yengs sems kyi lta stangs bral gyur na// yengs pa'i sems kyis de nyid rtog mi 'gyur// dngos po'i tshang tshing gseb tu de nyid nor bu stor// zhes gsungs pas/ ma yengs par bskyangs pas spyod lam rnam bzhir thon pa zhig 'ong*/ res dran pas ma bzung yang gsal stong 'dzin med du phyam phyam 'gro ba'ang 'ong ste/ mai tri pas/ mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag ces// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtog pa rang grol phyag rgya che// gnyis med mnyam par chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// ces gsungs pas/ de ltar yun ring du bskyangs pas thag chod nges shes nang nas 'char te/ bram ze chen pos/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// mgon po nga lta de ring 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs/

bsgom pa mthar phyin tsa na rtogs pa mngon 'gyur du sangs rgyas te/ rje mi las/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bdag gnyis sangs pas sangs// rang rig rang gsal ye shes rgyas pas rgyas// mi la bdag gis sangs rgyas de la bya// zhes gsungs/ sha ba ri pas/ btags pa'i yid ni dbyings su dag gyur par// de la rdo rje 'chang zhes btags pa tsam// zhes gsungs so// bde chen 'du 'bral med pa chos kyi sku// gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'o// ngo sprod mdor bsdus bris pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro kun rnam dag sku bzhi thob par shog /phyag rgya chen po lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi ngo sprod ma rig gi mun pa sel ba ye shes snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

772) ༄// phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gser khang sgo bcad ma// na mo ratna gu ru/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che de/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du phyag phebs nas tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu bskyangs/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i nyin zhag thams cad tshang ba'i nyin par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig spyan sngar bsags nas/ bka' stsal chen po gsungs nas/ chos phar la 'dri ba'i tshul du mdzad nas chos 'di rgyu gang las byung rkyen gang las byung gsungs pa la/ la la na re rgyu sems can las byung zer/ la la na re rgyu sangs rgyas las byung zer/ yang sems 'di ma rig las byung na/ ma rig pa rang gang las byung gsungs pa la/ thams cad 'dun pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas/ ma rig pa sems las byung zer/ khong rnam pa'i lan de la ji lta ba bzhin du mnyes pa ma byung nas/ chos rje nyid dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i dbon rin po che spyan sngar bos nas gong gi gsung de rnams khong la gsungs pas/ khong gi zhal nas sems bya ba gdod ma nas skye ba med pa/ yod med kyi mtha' dang bral ba sangs rgyas pa yang rang de rang yin/ de las chos byung bar mi 'dod zhus pas/ slob dpon spyan snga'i zhal nas/ de na 'byung ba mi 'dug pas nga la ma bde gsung*/ 'byung dbon gyis sa yod de 'dir mi 'jog gsung*/ de nas chos rje'i spyan snga nas/ bsngo ba zhig mdzad nas thams cad so sor bzhud du bcug go// de nas rgyun gtor ran pa'i dus su/ dbon rin po che/ mkhan rin po che/ slob dpon spyan snga ba rnams spyan sngar bos nas/ gser khang gi sgo bcad nas/ gzhan gcig kyang spyan sngar ma nyan/ de nas bka' stsal gsungs pa/ de ring gi chos de khong rnams la rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa zhig mi 'jog pa ci yin gsung*/ khong gi zhal nas da res kyi chos de go bar byed pa la/ rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/

sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa/ dbyer med pa zhig tu gyur nas sems kyi phu thag chod pa zhig dgos/ khong rnams la da res kyi chos 'di go bar byed pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug pas ma bzhag pa yin/ spyir rje rin po che lta bu sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon nas/ bu slob dpag tu med pa zhig bskyangs/ 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ gsung 'di yis thag chod pa dka' bar 'dug de dka' ba tsam du 'phrin las ji snyed cig 'byung ba yang*/ yang dag pa'i don la sems can gdul bya yin min gyis go ba 'di dka' bar 'dug des na do nub kyi dus 'dir chos zhu ba 'am/ zhu mkhan yang 'dzom/ rje'i spyan sngar zhu ba'i dus la yang bab pas/ sngon thog ma med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'khor ba la mtha' yod med cig zhu dgos zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ do nub kyi zhu ba 'di nyams dga'/ zhu mkhan bzang po yang 'dzoms pas 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa do nub sprugs dgos gsungs nas/ sngon thog ma med pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di ngo sprod dgos/ 'di ngo ma 'phrod na thog ma med pa rkyang par song nas/ go ba shin du dka' ba 'di khyod bden pa yin/ de la mi che dgu gnyan dgu mang po tshogs kyang*/ sems can dang sangs rgyas gang snga byas pa la rgyu sems can la 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin zer nas sems kyi phu thag ma chod pa'i rtags de rang yin pas/ ma rig pa sems las byung bya ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di yang*/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mnga' ma brnyes pas lan pa yin/ spyir yod med kyi mtha' dang bral nas yang dag pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du gyur na da ltar gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'ong ba'i don med pa la/ sngon byung gi dus su yang zag bcas kyi bde ba chen po dang yang ldan/ gzung 'dzin spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid kyang go la/ lam sbyangs pa'i thabs la mkhas kyang*/

shes rab mngon du ma gyur pas/ 'od gsal gyis gzugs med kyi khams na gnas pa'i lha rnams/ 'od gsal de dang dbyer med du gyur pa zhig shar nas yod pa'i dus su/ ya mtha' dang ma mtha' yod na/ de kho na la brten pas chog pa yin te/ de gang yang med pas da lta 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di byung ba yin/ de ya mtha' bya ba yin te/ nyon mongs pa chags sdang 'ba' zhig la longs spyad nas/ mi tshe sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la skyel ba zhig yod na/ de la brten nas thams cad ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes sems can thams cad kyi mgon du gyur pa 'gro ba'i bla ma zhig byon na/ da lta ba'i dus su 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di med par byed pa la de gcig pus chog de gnyis gang yang ma 'dzom pa'i dus da lta'i dus su khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bskyed pa yin te/ dus tshod de tsam na sa'i tshod grangs gar gnas snyam na/ sa dgu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yar la chos sku chen po mngon du ma gyur/ mar la nyon mongs pa chags sdang rag pa dang 'bring po gnyis dang bral tsam pa'i phra zhing phra ba bag la nyal de gnas pa'i gnad kas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'grig nas nang du sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/ nyon mongs pa phra zhing phra bas bsgribs nas phyi rol tu nam mkha' stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la rlung gi phung po chen po chags rgyu byung bas/ de la brten nas chu'i phung po chags/ de la rin chen gser chags/ de la brten nas sa chen 'di chags/ sa'i bcud bsdus pas bdud rtsi zhag tu song*/ de la dri ngad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas/ spyir thams cad gong du ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du phyi spros pa'i rang bzhin dang bral tsam de la yar sangs rgyas bya ba med/ mar 'khor ba zhes bya ba med/ dus de'i med pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan de lta bu yin/ de'i dus su sngar gyi dri ngad de rnams khong gis tshor rgyu zhig byung nas/

khong thams cad gros byas nas 'di 'dra ba sngan chad byung ma myong zer nas/ 'di'i rgyu ci yin rkyen ci yin/ ji lta ba bzhin du sngon du sus kyang gyur ma nus pas/ de la brten nas pho mo'i shan phyed/ sngar gyi phra zhing phra ba de rang yang dge bar ma slongs shing nyon mongs pa'i las spyad pas 'jig rten pa'i bu dang bu mo gnyis byung*/ khong gnyis la brten te rtsad gcod mkhan cig gdong zhig gis 'thud pas bcud sa zhag rin po che de ma zad kyi bar du thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams/ spyi dang bye brag med par rdzogs pa'i rting ma de nga yin/ nga yong tsam na khong rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du 'dres 'dug nga yi mug shin tu che bar byung nas/ lo bco lnga'i bar du yi mug dang ma bral nas/ de nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di nas yar 'dren pa la/ cis phan snyam du bsams pa la/ de yang lus ngag yid gsum gtso bor byas nas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ dag pa'i smon lam 'debs pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ bzhi po 'di la brten nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sna zin pa de thugs kyis gzigs pa yin pas/ des na sngon thog ma la 'khor bar khrid mkhan gyi bza' mi gnyis bu phrug gnyis dang bzhi po de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dus na bdud lha sbyin zer ba de/ dus tshod de na khong bza' mi gnyis la log rgyu ma byung nas/ kho blta ru phyin pas/ khong gnyis yar 'khrid ma shes/ yar 'ongs nas thams cad la 'di 'dra snang zhes bsgrag ma shes/ 'khor lnga sde bzang po de lam rim gyis khrid pa'i dang por slob gnyer thams cad rim gyis byas pa yin/ de la brten nas thams cad rim gyis khrid pa yin pas/ da rung ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur gyi bar lam khrid dgos par 'dug gsung*/

de nas yang dbon rin po ches/ ma rig pa 'di sems las byung ma byung bka' stsal zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod la dgos pa med de/ phyi rabs la dgos pa yin pas bya dgos gsung nas/ chu'i phugs gtsang na thams cad gtsang ba dang 'dra bar/ nga'i bka' srol na khyed thams cad bya sa bde/ phyi rabs mang po la yang lam sna myur bar 'ong ba yin gsung nas/ gong du ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du sa dgu pa'i yon tan dang ldan/ de la gnas par nus na'ang*/ 'di las lhag par btsal rgyu med par 'dod/ lar nam yang 'gro sa med par 'dod/ de ni 'dod pa bya ba yin/ zag bcas bde ba chen po'i chags sdang rags pa thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal yang*/ gzugs med khams kyi lha rnams la gnas pa'i 'od gsal de dang dbyer med gcig tu mtshungs pa de la chags pa zer ba yin/ des na 'dod chags de rang ngo ma shes pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i ngang nas gti mug zer ba yin/ des na 'khor ba 'di bskyed pa yin gsung*/ yang dbon rin po ches/ chos bya ba 'di gang las byung*/ rgyu mtshan bye brag dang bcas pa zhig zhu dgos zhus pas/ khyod kyi 'dod pa'i thog tu babs nas yod gsung*/ sangs rgyas las ma byung pa yang*/ yang dag pa'i don nam mkha' lta bu la chos kyi sgra med ming med/ mtshon tsam du btags pa med/ gang yang med pa dang bral nas yod pa la/ sems kyi rgyu lam rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la kun gzhi nam mkha' lta bu de dang dbyer med du mtshungs so// 'o na chos 'di gang las byung snyam na/ gong du gsungs pa bzhin du/ 'dod chags la brten nas ma rig pa/ de la rnam par rtog pas 'khor bar skyes/ chos kyang rnam rtog la brten nas byung ba yin/ rnam rtog med na chos med/ rnam rtog byung bas chos kyang byung ba yin gsung*/ de la slob dpon spyan snga bas/ ma rig pa'i rgyu 'di sems las 'ong dgos tsam 'dug pa la zhus pas/ dbus gtsang bas khams pa 'di glen zer ba'i thog tu babs par 'dug

khyod la yang de'i bag cig 'dug gsung*/ ma rig pa sems las 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan spyan snga nyid nas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ gser gyi thog tu la cha byugs na gser gyi rang bzhin gar yang ma song yang*/ gser gyi ngo bo mthong rgyu med pa de/ gser gyi skyon yin nam/ la cha'i skyon yin/ gser gyi skyon yin na/ la cha gser gyi nang na 'ong dgos par 'dug des na la cha'i skyon yin pa kho nas/ la cha de rtog par song rtog pa des de bkab pa de go ba min nam gsung*/ shel gong g.ya' dag pa'i rang bzhin la rtsi dmar pos g.yogs na shel gong gi rang bzhin du yod kyang*/ ngo bo mthong rgyu med de shel sgong gi skyon yin nam rtsi'i skyon yin/ shel sgong gi skyon yin na rtsi nang nas 'ong dgos/ des na rtsis phar la g.yogs pas rtsi kho nas rtog bcas su song bas/ rtog pas shel sgong phar la bkab pa yin/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dom dgu yan chod la rlung gis g.yo nus la/ de man chod la 'gul ba gcig kyang med de/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i skyon yin nam/ rlung gi skyon yin/ rgya mtsho'i skyon yin na gting nas g.yo dgos te/ rlung gi skyon yin pa kho nas/ 'dom dgu'i yan chod la g.yo nus pa yin gsung*/ de bzhin du rnam rtog gis sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa de phar la bkab pa yin/ da lta'i dus su nang du mtho dman dpag tu med pa zhig skye ba de yin/ phyi rol du yang las ngan dpag tu med pa zhig 'grub pa 'di yang*/ rnam rtog gi las ngan yin pas/ 'dir spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis las/ spang bya zhes rnam par rtog pa las gzhan zhig med/ gnyen po ni nang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di la blta shes pa zhig dgos/ 'on du lags kyang phyi rol gyi snang ba mang po 'gag dgos pas/ spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis su bya ba yin/ nged rang sgom chen pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na/

dbyer med gcig tu byas nas nyams su len pas/ bu chung la zla ba ston pa dang 'dra'o// de ci 'dra snyam na/ dang po'i dus su mdzug gu bstan de nas je mtho je mtho la btang nas/ lag pa brkyang bas zla ba de mthong ba yin/ sgom chen pa'i nyams len yang de dang khyad med/ gcig pur ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sdod pa rang la yang*/ sdod sa ri phug la byas nas rgyu 'grul mang po zhig 'ong ba 'di sems kyi skyon yin nam/ lus kyi skyon yin/ sems gdod ma nas skye ba med pa chos kyi sku la g.yo 'gul med/ lus 'byung ba bzhis bsdus kyi phung po'i gzugs su grub pa 'di yang*/ gang yang ma 'gul bar sdod mkhan byas pa de rang yin/ 'o na rgyu 'grul byed mkhan de gang yin snyam na/ de yang rnam par rtog pa yin pas/ rje tilli pa'i zhal nas/ gcig pur sdod cing ring du rgyu// lus med dbang po'i phug na gnas// 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed// gsung ste/ ngas rje phag mo gru pa la zhus/ gzhan thams cad ngas ma 'khums pa la sems 'dul byed/ bya ba 'di da rung bde mo byung zhus pas/ zhal snga nas/ sngon rje mar pas/ rgyud sde'i gsung mang po dper bcad pa la/ de 'dra ba'i sgra skyon du song ba la tshig bzhi sde cig yod gsung*/ phyis phyag rgya chen po'i don skye ba med pa la mngon du gyur nas/ phyi ta ma de la rgya gar nas tshur byon pa'i dus su dpe rnams lho brag na yod pa 'di rnams bcos dgos par 'dug pa'i thugs dgongs btang ba la/ de nas lho brag na mar la byon pa'i dus su mar pa rgyal sras bya ba'i slob ma che shos zhig gis dpe gal che shos de tsho/ lho sum pa'i yul du khyer nas song bas/ des na tshig de tsho ma 'gyur ba yin/ ngas kyang dgon par bsdad pa'i dus tshod du bla ma'i gsung nyams su blangs pa min pa dpe cig kyang bcad pa med/ khyod kyang sgom 'di'i don rang bzhin gyis sngon du gyur nas 'ong bas/

spyir yang rgyu 'bras kyi chos mngon du gyur pa la phal cher zhig dgos pa yin/ skye shi bar do 'di rang la 'byung nges pa khyod yin/ gsung de la brten nas nyams su blangs pas thams cad skad cig ma la 'byung yang 'byung*/ da gcig pur sdod mkhan gang yin snyam na/ gsum tshogs kyi rten 'brel yin gsungs/ ring du rgyu mkhan ni rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa 'di yin/ 'dug rgyu yang rnam par rtog pa 'di yin/ 'di la nan chags su ma byas par song na khyed kyi zhu ba dang 'dra bar gzhan yang ma go ba mang po yong nyen gda' bas/ 'dul mkhan skye ba med pa chos sku yin/ de gnyis kyang dbyer med du byas nas nyams su blangs pa ma gtogs pa dus nam du yang spang blang gi rgyu med/ spyir nga'i chos 'di go dka'/ go ba'i steng la chos thams cad 'di'i thog tu yong bas thams cad khrol nas yong*/ spyi khyab tu ma rig pa'i kha skad 'di yang gong du ma gsungs pa med pas ma chog pa med kyang gzhan la dgos pa yod pas/ nan chags zhig byed dgos gsungs nas rnam rtog ma rig pa las byung*/ ma rig 'dod chags las byung*/ 'dod chags kyi rgyu 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa yin la/ skye ba med pa chos kyi sku 'di la 'byung ba rnam pa lngas ma gos pa/ dri ma med pa de rang yin*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang nyams len rgyu lnga ldan las med/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su chos lnga ldan 'di phyi da ba la gsungs pa yin/ de mgon po zla 'od gzhon nus go nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa yin/ de nyan thos rnams kyi thugs su ma shong nas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i thugs su ma shong bas srid pa bar ma do min pa ngos ma 'phrod pa yin/ nga'i chos 'di mang tshod kyi thal cig yin yang*/ bka' gdams kyi dge bshes gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya bas kyang dga' ba yin/ yang dbon rin po ches sngon dang po'i 'khor ba byed mkhan gyi lnga po des da lta'i dus su/

gdul bya gar mdzad zhus pas/ spyir thugs rje chen po yang nga yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyang nga yin/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan gyi gdul bya thams cad pas/ da lta'i gdul bya'i khams che ba yin/ 'on kyang pha de rje btsun spyan ras gzigs yin/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur gyi bar du bzhugs pa yin/ ma de gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yin/ de yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du bzhugs pa yin/ las dge sdig gi shan 'byed cing sdod dgos pa yin/ bu mo de yi dwags kyi rgyal mo gzi brjid can yin/ des yi dwags thams cad las ngan pa las bsgyur zhing mtho ris la 'god nus pa yin/ bu de dmyal ba'i a ba glang mgo yin/ sems can gyi las ngan zad pa dang bde ba la 'god nus pa yin/ khong gi cig de lha sbyin yin/ lha sbyin med na spyir bcom ldan 'das la gdul bya chen po mi 'ong*/ dgos su yang rgyal blon chen po rnams mi thul bas kho la brten nas 'phrin las bzhi mdzad pa yin gsung*/ 'o na kho la bka' bsgo mdzad pa yin nam/ smon lam btab pa yin zhus pas/ smon lam yang btab/ bka' bsgo byas te/ nga dkar por byung na khyod nag por shog nga dmar por byung na khyod sngon por shog nga ser por byung na khyod khra bor shog gsungs pa dang*/ ming bdud du thogs so// de yan chod kyis sangs rgyas rabs brgya'i gdul bya rdzogs pa yin/ spyir rten gyi gang zag la brten nas chos sgor zhugs pa lta ngo mtshar che ste/ bla ma bzang po 'tshol shes dgos/ rtsa ba'i bla ma su dga' dgas mi yong bas/ phyag rgya chen po don mngon du gyur nas/ gzhan gyi rgyud tshod rang la 'char nus pa zhig dgos/ de yan chod rtsa ba'i bla ma'o// 'dren pa'i bla ma rang la'ang*/ gong ma'i gsung bzhin brjod cing 'khor ba la/ gong nas gong du gsol ba 'debs pa'i gnas bstan nas/ rang gzhan thams cad gong ma'i rjes su 'khrid pa de la 'dren pa'i bla ma'o// dpe tshogs la bskor log byas nas bshad pa brengs se ba de ma gtogs pa man ngag sbreng rgyu gcig kyang med nas gdams pa gzhan thams cad la 'bar cing*/

'khor rnams rang gcig pu'i rtsar mgo bskor ba de nyan thos kyi slob dpon bya ba yin/ lta spyod de dang ma bral na bskal pa'i bar du sdod dgos/ de nas khong rnam pa gsum po so sor bzhud nas/ gser dngul dang dar yug gi phyag rten phul nas bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags pa'i zhu ba gsol bas/ chos rje'i zhal nas nga las khong khyed la drin che ba yin/ kho med na ngas tshogs pa 'di rnams mi skyong*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sngon chos rje sgam po pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ rje sgom tshul gyis gdan sa mi yong zer nas/ thams cad kyi phag mo gru pa la gsol ba btab pas/ khong gi lcam sring mos sman drangs pas des rten 'brel 'chugs nas gdan sa byed pa ma byung ba yin/ rje phag mo gru pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su shul der dbon po gcig tsam zhig yod na yang de la brten nas bstan pa yong ba la/ ngam shod lung pa'i mi rnams bla ma dam pa'i bu nga yin zer ba mang yang bdag po yong ba gcig kyang med/ des na kho bo cag kyang khur chen po khur dgos pa byung nas gdan sa chen po'i zhabs tog tu song ba bla ma mnyes pa'i 'phrin las chen po bsgrubs kyang*/ 'or che tsam zhig lta ga la 'ong la/ ma legs pa skad zer nas thams cad kyi tshur la 'jug par 'dug de kho nas kho drin che ba yin/ spyir yang nga kho yin kho nga yin/ sang phod 'phrin las chen po bsgrub dgos pa'i dus tshod cig la kho mnyes por bcug nas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang mthu dpung dang stong grogs byed dgos pa yang yong ba yin no// da res kyi chos 'di dbang po 'bring stod kyi chos yin/ shin tu sba ba gal che bas dper ma bkod cig gsung*/ slob dpon spyan snga bas gzhan la mi ston par rang gcig pus tshags byed par zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyang nga'i bslab bya gdan sa 'di la mig tsig tsig 'dug ste/ khyod rang yang phag mo grur thod pa skyur bar grags gsung*/

tshags byed pa bgyis te/ nga'i chos 'di gya tshom du brjod mi rung gsung*/ de nas dbon rin po ches sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su 'gro ba la ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim thams cad 'dzegs nas them pa gcig gnyis las ma thon nas ldog pa dang 'dra ba bzhin du/ sngon gyi dus su yang sa dgu pa non pa la brten nas/ bla ma gcig med pas sa bcu pa 'gong ma nus pas/ de la bltas nas da lta'i dus su bla ma dam pa'i drin lan du song na ba spu'i bu ga gcig bskyed pa'i yon tan 'bum gyur gyi char yang mi phod de/ da lta'i dus su ngo bsrung gi zhabs tog kyang 'ong bar dka' bar 'dug zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sems can la re ba bstan pa cig la brgya stong yang mi 'gro /dpal mgon byed pa bla ma gtso che/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos 'khor lnga brgya la sems bskyed pa mdzad pas/ bslab bya nyams pas skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu rta lnga brgyar skyes pa la/ khong rta cang shes shig tu skye ba bzhes nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa der ma byon na/ skye ba bco lnga'i bar du der sdod dgos pa yin/ des bcom ldan 'das la brten nas skye ba de'i 'og rol tu ngan song nas thon nas sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su skyes pa yin/ da lta'i dus 'dir yang chos 'di dang 'brel nas nga la gsol ba 'debs dgos pa yin/ nga mi rabs bco lnga'i bar du song yang rtsa ba'i bla ma byas pas chog pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sngon rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la chos slob pa bas kyang bsgom pa gal che ba'i bka' sgo yod pa yin te/ khong thugs shes rab la 'byams pas/ na ning dus tshod du rta chags la skyo sangs la phyin tsam na/ gzod phyag rgya chen po'i zhu gtug byed dgos byung ba yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yer pa bya ba zhig rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal mthong gsung thos kyang rtsa ba'i bla mar byar ma shes nas/

dpal stag lung thang par zhabs tog byas pa la/ phyis 'das mchod kyang khong gi dus mchod byed nas rin po che de la ma btud par 'dug pas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas na/ mgo zhabs nas mar la btags pa yin/ rang yang kha rje dang dbang thang ldog gam chung du 'gro ba yin/ da res kyi chos 'di la yon chen po zhig 'dod pas khyed spun du yod gsung*/ lnga yod zhus pas/ lnga tshigs de nga la phul cig gsung*/ yab yum gyi dbu mdzad thams cad 'bul lo zhus pas/ 'o khyod kyi pha rgan yang 'dir thon par 'dug gsung*/ nga'i chos 'di yang shin tu mngar te khyod kyi yon yang che/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi zas nor snying gsum thams cad 'bul ba bas/ khyod kyi spun zla 'di tshogs 'gyur gyi che ba yin/ spyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na nga la dgra ba spu tsam yang med/ rgya nag po gyen du log byang phyogs lho ru song*/ nub shar phyogs su song yang*/ nga la gdul bya cher 'gro ba ma gtogs pa nyams mi nus pa yin gsung*/ yang dbon rin po ches/ nyi ma lho nub kyi phyogs 'd-i ma bde ba zhig byung zhus pas/ ma bde ba de khyod gdul bya che ba'i rtags yin/ slob dpon spyan snga ba la yang khyod kyis kyang kho la nam dgos pa'i dus su rogs dan la 'bungs shig gsung*/ yang lha sbyin gyi gdul bya gar yod zhus pas/ phyogs mi gsung nas rgyal po chen po gcig tu yod de yong gsung*/ 'phrin las che chung zhus pas/ bstan pa 'di la nga la 'dud pa mang po zhig 'byung na 'phrin las kyang che ba de rang yin gsung*/ 'di la gab tshig cig yod/ des chog gsung*/ do nub dgong mo 'o cag pha spad kyi chos 'di dmar ba yin gsung*/ de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba la bsngo ba mdzad do// phyi de nang gong gi dus su dbon rin po ches/ phyag dpe la bkod nas/ dam chos theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di// bdud rtsi bcud kyi yang snying yin// ma rig 'khrul pa rtsad nas gcod// 'khor ba mtha' ma yod par go// brgyud pa dpag tu med pa cig

/gzhan gyis snang bar byon lags kyang*// ngo bo rang bzhin chos sku yin// mtshan nyid bla ma dam pa yin// dus da res byon pa ngo mtshar yang*// mos gus can la 'bral rgyu med// dal 'byor thob pa'i skye bo rnams// zang zing nor phyir ma 'breng bar// bla ma rje la gsol ba thob// dge ba 'dis mtshon bsod nams kyis// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// sdug bsngal nad las thar gyur cig /bde skyid gter la spyod pa dang*/ bla med byang chub myur thob shog /chos 'di la dpe gsum las med do// dbon rin po che/ mkhan po rin po che/ spyan snga rin po che dang gsum gyi phyag tu re re yod/ gser khang sgo bcad ma rdzogs so// //

773) ༄// phyag rgya chen po gser khang sgo bcad ma'i rgyab chos// na mo gu ru/ dang po kun bzang thog med yang thig las// dpal kun tu bzang pos 'di skad gsungs// nga ni 'gro 'dul tshogs spyod legs ston che// byang phyogs kha ba can du nga nyid 'ong*// ming ni rin chen dpal zhes pa// sa bcu'i sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'dus pa khri phrag mang po'i dbus na bzhugs// rigs gsum mgon po la sogs kyi// thugs rgyud bdag gis smin par byed// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen ni// ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khrul ma myong ba yin gsung ba lags/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo las/ 'khor ba dang po chags dus lam lnga la gyes nas chags pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di kun tu bzang pos gzigs nas/ thugs mug skyes par gyur pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho skems par dgongs nas/ dang po yig tshang ka kha bslab// bar du tshul sdom gtsang sbra bslab// mtha' ma theg pa bsam mi khyab// ces pa dang*/ 'khrul ma myong gi sangs rgyas chos rje rin po che yin gsungs pa'i bka' stsal byon pa la/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga ni tha dad ston cing gcig tu gnas// gcig tu gnas shing tha dad ston// ye shes lus can bdag gis ni// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// mun pa'i khrod du 'khyams ma myong*// bdag ni dam pa'i phar phyin pas// shes bya'i don la mkhas pa yin/ gsung*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mnga' brnyes pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad thugs su chud pas/ ma rig pa sems las byung ma byung shes pa 'ong ba lags/ don dam me long snying po las// sems nyid don dam 'dres med la// ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'dres kyang med/ gsung*/ don dam rnam nges kyi mdo las kyang*// dag pa skyon med sems nyid 'di// nyes skyon ma rig tshogs dang bral// zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pa'i lung dpag tu med pa yod kyang de las go bar mi nus na/

bden par smra ba rnams la go ba gang gis len na 'di ltar lags gsung*/ yang dag pa'i don nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ ma rig pa gcig pa'i don ci la yod/ las kyi rlung glo bur las byung ba dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung dri mas ma gos pa dang gcig par gar yod/ nang du rgyu tshul yang mi gcig ste/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rgyu ba las kyi rlung ma rig pa yin/ dbus su rgyu ba'i rlung ni ye shes yin/ zag bcas g.yas g.yon gnyis na rgyu/ zag med dbu ma'i nang nas rgyu ba yin/ rtsa ngos 'dzin gyi rgyu lugs zhal snga nas gsungs pa 'dir ma bkod pa lags/ spyir ni dngul dang dngul rdo lta bu yin te/ dngul rdo las dngul ma byung dngul las dngul rdo ma byung*/ dngul dang dngul rdo mi gcig de bzhin du sems dang ma rig pa gcig las gcig ma byung*/ 'dres pa min te lhan skyes su ma byung*/ ma rig pa sems ma yin/ sems dang ma rig pa gcig pa yang ma yin/ sems la ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa la sems kyi yon tan gcig kyang med/ sems la ni ma rig pa las sems kyang med/ phar phyin nas sems la sems ma mchis ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la sogs/ zhes pa dang*/ sems ni nam mkha' yongs su dwangs pa dang 'dra la/ ma rig pa sa'i drod gsher 'dus pa las na bun sprin dang khug snas mdangs bkab pa dang*/ rgya mtsho'i steng rlung gis g.yos pa dang*/ shel sgong rtsis g.yogs pa dang*/ gser la la chas g.yogs pa dang*/ nyi ma sprin gyis g.yogs pa la sogs pa/ dpe lnga ni zhal snga nas gsungs pas/ glo ba'i rtsa nang nas byung ba ma rig pa'i rlung*/ snying dang srog rtsa 'dres ma nas rgyu ba ye shes kyi rlung*/ glo ba nas rgyu ba'i rlung gis srog rtsa nas rgyu ba'i rlung phar la bkab pas ma rig pa'i ma rig pa yin/ 'byung bzhis stobs bskyed pa ma rig pa yin/ rtsa gnyis po'i rlung gi rgyu lugs kyi ngo sprod des go bar byed pa yin/

spyir rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad de dang 'dra bar spu ris mi 'dor bar yod pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ni gcig tu dkar ba rnams ni gcig tu dkar/ gcig du nag pa rnams ni gcig tu nag gsungs pas/ sems nyid gdod ma nas 'dus ma byas pa dri ma med pa nyag gcig pu skyon dang bral ba dang*/ ma rig pa rgyu rkyen las skyes pa gnyis mi gcig go ma go ni mkhyen pa'i ye shes yod med kyi khyad par yin gsung*/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi zhus lan ni/ chos rje rten 'phyag la byon nas gdan sum rim mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i dus su/ skyob pa dang dbang sdud kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ rtsa g.yon pa'i nang du dzā byed ye shes kyi rlung nang du chud pas/ phyi rol nas 'jam dbyangs chos zhu ru byon pa la/ gsung rnam par thugs la rgyun tshugs nas sku zhi ba'i ngo bos chos bstan/ 'jam dbyangs kyis kyang phyag chen gtan la phebs pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs rigs gsum mgon po yin pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di 'dzin pa'i ring la rigs gsum mgon po sa bcu'i sems dpar bzhugs gsung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa ci tsam 'dzin pa tsam gyis sa bcu'i sems dpa' yang shes bya srab tu 'gro ba lags/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo des 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don byed pa rgyud lung kun na gsal/ dpal 'bri gung pa 'di nyid rnam snang dang po'i rgyud nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin par gsungs pa dang*/ sa bcu'i sems dpa' rnams kyi bla mar 'byon par gsungs pa dang*/ 'bri sgang rten 'phyag ces bya ba der/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'jam dbyangs kyis sems kyi sgro 'dogs gcod ces pa'i lung yod pa yin/ sku rnam snang dang po rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par thar pa'o// lho nub phyogs 'dir ma bde ba cig byung bya ba 'di yang khyod kyi gdul bya yin zhes pa ni/

sngon nub phyogs tsaṇḍa ta zhes bya ba na/ kho bo chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgron ma zhes bya ba gcig tu skyes pa yin/ de'i dus su khyod dbon rin po che byang chub sems dpa' sgra 'byin dbang phyug yin/ kho ni gong gi rgyal po chen po zhig tu yod ces dge slong 'od kyi sgra bya ba yin/ de'i dus na kho dang khyod la rim gro'i 'brel dang dam tshig cig yod pas kho khyod kyi gdul byar 'ong ba yin/ de yang kho lho nub phyogs su med na khyod kho'i 'gro sa der 'gro dgos yong nas khyod kyang dge slong gi tshul mi thub cing tshe la bar chad yong ba dang*/ nga'i brgyud pa rin po che 'di yang chad pa yin te ma legs pa yin/ de yang kho lho nub phyogs su yod pas legs pa yin gsung*/ da nga'i mi brgyud rin po che 'di dar te/ tha ma sgom ma ra lug can rnams kyis bu chung pang zhing them pa 'dzin pa'ang yong ba yin/ des na ma bde ba de khyod kyi gdul byar 'ong ba yin pas 'di la phrag ma dog dang legs pa yin/ da khyod rang nas bzung ste/ mi rab bcu gcig gam bcu gnyis nas khyod rang gnas 'dir gdul bya'i lhag ma lus pa de skyongs/ de'i dus su ma bde ba de khyod kyi zhabs la gtug cing gdul bya yin/ phyogs bzhi phyogs log kyang nga la dgra med/ gnam chags sa rdib kyang mi rabs drug gi ring la dgra med/ lar dbon rin chen kho la khur chen po 'khur dgos pa'i dus na khyed spyan snga ba/ mkhan po rin po che gnyis pos kyang kho'i grogs dan gyis/ nga'i gnas 'di la chags 'jig 'ong na yang khos lan pa ma yin/ de yang rgyu mtshan zhig gis 'ong ba'i dgos pa yod pas mi lto ba'i rgyu mtshan yod/ de ma byung na gser gyi zam pa 'dra ba'i brgyud pa 'di 'chad pas de byung bas mi sto/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ dgos nga'i chos brgyud 'dis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'dzin pa yin/

'di'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ sngon lha sbyin gyis smon lam btab pa khyod kyi bstan pa dkar po 'di ngas nag por bshig par gyur cig byas pa'i tshe/ ngas smon lam btab pa/ khyod sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas byed cing 'gro ba skyob par shog cig ces smon lam btab pa yin/ yang khos ngas khyod kyi gnas mal la gnod pa dang bshig par gyur cig /ces pa'i tshe/ ngas smon lam btab pa khyod kyi de ltar gyur pa na/ nga'i lha chos mi chos dar "C zhing khyod 'dul ba dang 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'gro ba'i mgon du gyur cig byas pa yod pa yin gsung*/ nub phyogs tsaṇḍa ta na dge slong 'od kyi sgra bya ba des rim 'gror byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyed ni rin che bas khyed kyi 'khor dang khyed rang gi tshab tu skyon yon gang dgos byed par shog bdag dang bdag gi brgyud pa yang dar zhing rgyas pa dbang phyug dang ldan par shog nam zhig khyed kyi zhabs la gtugs nas ni/ mkhyen brtse'i thugs rjes 'dzin par shog /ces pa'i smon lam yod pa yin gsung*/ ku bai ra'i phug na yod pa'i dus su/ lhas sbyin gyis sgyogs 'phangs nas rkang pa'i mthe bong la sgyogs phog dus yin pa la shing tshal pa zug pa'i dus na/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis kho'i sde dang grong khyer bcom pa'i rgyu 'bras kyang yin/ smon lam dang rgyu'i lan chags gnyis ka yin pas res zhig la mi sto/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'dud pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ dar rgyas ci tsam che na nga'i bstan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa ci tsam dar ba nga'i bstan pa yin/ lar ma rig pa sems las ma byung ba 'di ma shes pa yang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tha dad ma go bas lan pa yin pas/ shes bya'i don la mkhas dgos pa lags/ lar sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku dang*/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam rtog dang gnyis 'dres nas 'od gsal chen po nam mkha' dang 'dra ba zhig byung na go nas 'ong ba yin/

gzhan ni ma go ba bden pa yin/ bag chags kyi sa bon ngan pa zad na sems mngon du gyur pa bya ba yin/ sa bon bzang po kun gzhi de la zer ba ste/ bzang po de ngan pa'i skyon gyis sgrib pa yin/ sgribs pa la sems can zer ba dang bag chags bzang po'i rkyen dang bral ba la sangs rgyas zer ba yin/ bag chags ngan pa la ma rig pa'i lus zer bas/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'khor bar 'khor ba yang lus kyi 'khor los 'khor bya ba yang*/ 'byung ba bzhis gcig gis gcig stobs bskyed nas kun gzhi rnam par dag pa de phar la sgribs nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rkyen dbang dang 'khor los bskor ba yin pa min nam/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dri ma 'di ci tsam du dag na sems nyid gdod nas dag pa je gsal la 'gro bas 'di go dgos/ des sdig pa mi dge ba dang dkor dang drin la lan dang dam tshig bsrung sdom rnams dgos pa yin/ sems nyid chos sku las dge sdig ma grub kyang rkyen gyi g.yogs pa zhig yin pas/ de sems shing rkyen dang bral dgos pa yin gsung*/ 'byung ba bzhis nyon mongs pa'i stobs bskyed nas bag chags bskyed dbang je che la song nas mngon zhen dang 'dzin pa je che la song bas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'ongs pa yin mod/ sems 'byung thams cad ma rig pa/ ma rig pa rkyen skyes 'byung ba bzhi/ des na sngon sangs rgyas dang sems can ma dbye ba'i dus der/ rkyen bla ma dam pa dang mjal na bag chags lam du slongs nas sangs rgyas 'ong ba la/ rkyen ngan pa 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud dang phrad pas/ 'khor bar song ba yin/ dang po'i dus der bag chags kyi dri ma dag bya ba de yang blo'i bag chags phra mo zhig yod pa de rang gi ma rig pa de rig pas na/ rgyu rkyen gyi mkhan pos rtags dpyad byed mkhan shes par byas nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gal che ba lags so/// / 1$0000240774) ༄// zab chos las 'phros pa'i sngon byung gtam gyi lo rgyus//1$0000360

byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed bya ba gzugs mdzes pa zhig yod pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo dpal yon bya ba'i sgo drung du bsod snyoms la byon pas/ bu mos bsod snyoms phul nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzugs mdzes pas/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' la chags pa'i stobs chen po skyes nas/ bu mo chags pa'i rlung log nas tshe'i dus byas pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes/ byang chub sems dpa' chags pa'i rgyun la mnyam par bzhag nas bsgom pas/ sa drug gi rtogs pa yod pa sa bcu ru na 'phar ba lags par gda'// ༈ //yang bla ma zhu yas dngos grub bya ba/ phag gnyis chags pa spyod pa mthong bas 'dod chags drag po skyes/ chags pa'i rgyun la mnyam par bzhag pas/ chags pa bde stong du rtogs/ phyis lam 'bras kyi grub thob bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa lags par gda'// ༈ //yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen ar bya ba/ dar yul la 'o che la byon pas/ la khar bu mo khyo la mi dga' ba zhig bros nas byung ba dang 'dzoms pas/ bu mo rum du bcug nas gzims pa/ bu mo chags pa skyes pa dge bshes kyi zhal nas/ khyod kyis nga la pha'i 'du shes zhog gsungs nas/ dge bshes kyang chags pa skyes kyang sdom pa ma shor ba zhig byas pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dar ba zhig bya dgos snyam pa'i snying rus chen po mdzad pas sang nang par bu mo pha yul na mar slebs tsa na/ bu mos pha ma la sngar gyi lo rgyus tsho smras pas/ 'di na mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang ba 'byon gyi yod byas pas/ pha mas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ar gdan drangs nas/ chos rgyas 'bring rnam gsum phul/ brgya 'bul la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas par gda'/ phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen ar gyi lugs pha rol tu phyin pa dus deng sang yan du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ des na dge 'dun rnams tshul khrims rin po che la gces spras su mdzod/ 'dod chags kyi nyes pa la yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa yin gsungs/// /chos rje rin po che shar gyi dwags lha sgam por byon nas/

gdan sa 'dir 'byon pa la dwags po/ nga rab dgang shul na yar 'byon pa'i dus su/ lha rje sman nag des mdzo dkar po zhig bzhon nas yod pas/ mo ma zhig gis 'dir rgyal 'gong byung zer nas sa gtor rdo gtor byas pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ 'di kun la yang phyogs ris tig tig 'dug kho de tsug yod pa yin gsungs// ༈ //yer pa zhang btsun bgyi ba la khams gzhi byung ba la/ gzhan thams cad kyis mtshams gyis zer ba la/ nga de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong zhig yin pas mtshams mi gcod/ phan yang skyabs 'gro byed/ ma phan yang skyabs 'gro byed zer nas dkon mchog gsum la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ dus tshod gcig tu rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skyes nas/ smyon pa slob tor smra ba bzhin du rang dbang med par skyabs su 'gro ba byas pas/ bdag yer pa zhang btsun zhes bgyi ba sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// chos don dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun 'phags pa'i dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa la skyabs su mchi'o// zer ba'i dus na/ spyi bo nas yar klu chen po zhig zangs kyis thon nas bdag gi ming ni zur phud rgyu 'dal zhes bgyi ba yang*/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zer nas song skad/ de nas yer pa zhang btsun gyi mdze sangs kyis sos par 'dug/ ༈ //gnyis pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen khams pa lung pa yang khams gzhi byung nas/ khong dge bsnyen lags par gda' ba la/ sngar zhang btsun gyi skad zer nas skyabs 'gro byas pas/ nub cig rmi lam na klu btsan bud nas thu ba na yod pa de/ dge bshes ston pas ri ral gyi ral gu zhig gon nas byung ba'i phu thung kha pho che de'i nang du klu de bcug nas bor ba rmis pas/ khams sangs kyis phan pa lags par gda'/ skyes bu de kun la gdams ngag 'di lta bu ni med/ dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su blo nges pa tsam yin pa la/

yon tan de lta bu byung na/ gdams ngag 'di lta bu nyams su blangs pas ci'i phyir 'bras bu mi 'byung mi srid pas/ 'bad 'bungs thon gsungs// ༈ //gnyis pa e ru jo gdan zla mdzes bgyi ba yod pas/ kho nyin cig 'khor ba la yid phyung nas/ bdag dus thams cad du dge slong gi sdom pa rin po che dang ldan par bya/ de yang thams cad du dge slong du bya snyam nas/ 'dun pa de'i rjes su bdag sangs ma rgyas kyi bar thams cad du/ dge slong gi sdom pa de bsrung bar gyur cig ces dam bca' brtan po zhig skyes pa'i tshe/ mdun du dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku las ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag tu yar 'bar ba zhal khro gnyer dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal lha'i mo sku las me dpung thur la 'bar ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa gnyis byon nas/ lha mo'i zhal nas ming po'i bsam pa de bzang*/ khyod kyi yon bdag ngas bya gsung skad/ dge 'dun rnams spyod pa ci ngan ngan byas na chos skyong de mi mchi/ chos skyong chos skyong ba yin mod/ 'dir yang ma mgon gnyis la 'gro 'ong yod pa ma yin/ gong gi bsrung sems brtan po'i bsam pa bzang po de skyes pas de ltar byung ba yin mod/ de ltar du go bar byed dgos pas/ tshul khrims rin po che rtse gcig tu bsrung dgos pa gal che// ༈ //gsum pa chos rje rin po che e chung dgon phug tu lo bdun bzhugs pa la/ lo drug thal nas bdun pa'i ngo byung ba la/ sku lus kyi smin mtshams man chad kyi dbu lo yang byi/ smin mtshams yan chod la ma shor ba ni/ chos rje phag mo gru pa'i ring bsrel zhig dbu skra la bzhugs pas de'i byin rlabs su 'dug ri khrod du sdod pa la rten lus la bcang ba yang gal che bar 'dug gsung*/ rten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang po'o// de'i dus su snyung de la thams cad kyis skyug bro bltas/ skad re gtong ba la yang bros nas 'gro bar 'dug pas da ni ma nyan nas 'dug

ci byed dgos thugs dgongs mang po btang bas 'gro sa yang mi gda'/ ba lu me tog khra yel ba chags pa gcig dang*/ za 'og khyim ma nogs pa thong chu gcig yod na rten 'brel gyis snyung dwangs par dgongs nas/ bla ma yel la 'phrin mang du btang yang*/ tha ma bal bu mes tshigs pa'i 'phro gcig dang*/ za 'og rnying pa thong cha gcig yongs pa dang thugs chad/ nang zhig thugs dgongs btang*/ nyi ma shar rting brag dkar la khar 'gro la rdza dong zhig brus/ de'i nang du zhugs nas sku srog chos kyis bcad la 'pho ba mdzad dgongs nas bshegs pa la/ gnam sgo 'og ma'i steng du byon pa la/ dbu sngas na chos rje phag mo gru pa'i sku gcig dang*/ jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku gcig bzhugs pa dran pas nga la khams gzhi byung ba bla ma dang yi dam gyis ni ma lan/ phyi phyag cig byed dgos dgongs nas rings sha dang bred thabs su phyi phyag la yar log ste/ 'di sngas na rten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis par bzhed par gda'/ de nas bla ma dang jo bo la mar me mdzad kyin brkyang phyag gsum mdzad pa'i phyi ta'i dus su snying rje 'khrig pa gcig byung ba la/ sngags pa'i rgyud par song bas/ chos la thugs rus che bas/ snying rje de ngos zin nas/ de la long ba glang gzhug tu mdzad/ shi med ko med du bsgoms pas/ snying rje'i stobs che bar song bas/ thugs dgongs la bdag da lta snyung nad 'di lta bu yod kyang mi lus rin po che thob/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal/ rtogs pa dang yon tan du ma mnga'/ rigs drug tu skyes pa rnams la yang sdug bsngal 'di lta bu yod dgongs nas/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems yang yang bsgom pas/ lar mi lus la rgyal po lta bu zhugs pa'i dus na/ 'tshang re 'jug par gda' ste/ dang po zhabs kyi mdzu gu rnams nas byi ba mang po bud nas song*/ de'i rjes la khong pa'i nang nas mdzo g.yag la sogs pa rta bong spyang ki la sogs pa bud nas song*/

de'i rjes la gzod rgyal po de bud nas song*/ de'i rjes na mar klu ril ril 'jigs su rung ba che ba rtsub pa mgo bo rmug pa thul thul byed pa zhig bud/ de phyed tsam bud pa'i dus na btang snyoms dum pa cig la ldog pa'i phyis su byung ba la snying rje'i rgyun de bsring pas/ e'i lung pa de gang ba bud nas song*/ dpyid kyi dus snga mo rang yin pa la/ thog nas tshur la 'brug tshag tshag grags nas ser ba che ba zhig kyang babs/ de ru sku lus sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde ba zhig byung dgyes grags pas phyi ru phyin tsa na/ nyi ma dgong kha grong pa ba ra 'jug pa'i dus su song nas 'dug skyo bsangs byed pa'i sa steng

phyis de la sgrol ma la steng zer zhig yod par byon pas 'phags ma sgrol ma bdun zhal gzigs/ sgrol ma bdun la gsol 'debs kyi bstod pa skyabs bdun ma yang mdzad// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi chos ma lus pa thugs la bkra lam gyis shar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyang zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu rtogs/ de phyin chad thun gcig kyang bsgom ma myong*/ sgom yang ma dgos/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel 'ba' zhig tu rtogs su chud// zhag gsum dro bzhi'i nang par na// mi kho'i las ngan rang sar dag /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan gcig go// zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug cig yin nam snyam// gsung ba'i tshigs bcad tsho mdzad nas/ zhal po yang mdzad/ sngar gyi thugs dgongs kyi bal lu me tog khra chem me dang*/ za 'og zi khyim yang gzod byung*/ bla ma yal e'u 'dum ra na yod pa'i dus na/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha e chung dgon phug tu byon nas/ chos rje la dbang bskur zer ba'i grags pa chen po byung bas/ bla ma yal 'dum ra sa nas e chung dgon phug tu byon/ chos rje'i snyung de sngar ma gsan pa der snyan du thos/ sku khams dwangs pa de la dga' tshor chen po mdzad/ sha chang mang po khyer nas tshogs 'khor 'bul ba mdzad nas khyed la bram ze chen po byon nas dbang bskur zer ba'i grags pa chen po byung*/ de thugs la btags gsung nas tshig gi btang rag mdzad/ mdor na 'jig rten 'di na slob dpon birwa pa grags pa che ste/ de bas kyang lhag pa rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur gsungs/ des na de lta bu'i tshad med pa'i snying rje dgos pas/ de las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes pa yin te/ lan brgya rtsa la sogs pa nan tan chen po bskyed dgos pa yin te/ stobs su gyur nas skyon thams cad dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa zhig yong ba yin/ des na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/

nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ tshad med pa las byung ba'i snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ dbang rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis dang*/ chos bzhi po 'di la dus rgyun chad med par nyams su len par zhu// ༈ //sangs rgyas spyan chen po'i spyan sngar/ dge slong bstan pas smon lam btab pa/ bdag la nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi bsam pa skad cig ma gcig skyes kyang*/ bdag mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgya bar ma gyur cig zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog thams cad 'gre/ de ltar nyams su len pas nyon mongs pa gang gis kyang 'khrug par ma nus pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa zhes mtshan gsol ba de lta bu yin// ༈ //lo tsā ba rin po che bzang pos/ jo bo rje la gsang sngags kyi nyams len gyi rim pa zhus nas/ ca ye sgom phug tu byon nas/ phug de'i phyi sgo'i ya them la/ gnas khang 'di yi nang du/ tha mal pa'i rnam par rtog pa skad cig ma gcig skyes kyang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgo bo tshal pa brgyad du khos shig zer ba bris nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor zhal mthong*/ phyis mkha' spyod du gshegs pa lags par gda'/ de la chos rje'i zhal nas/ de lta bu'i brtul zhugs byas na mkha' spyod 'gro ba la tshegs med pas/ bu kun snying rus chen pos dam pa'i chos nyams su longs dang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ba yin gsungs// ༈ //slob dpon padma'i gtam rgyud ni/ sngon dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i dus su snang srid lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis rtsig dbang ma byung pa la/ slob dpon padma saṃ bha ba rgya gar nas byon nas/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre rnams btul/ na len dra la dpe byas nas bzhengs par yin par gda'/ de la bod khams tsam gyi rten 'brel yang zhugs shing*/

ka ba stong rtsa gnyis yod pa de yang*/ bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis 'byon pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gyi bstan pa'i bya ba dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ slar rgya gar yul du phar zhud pa'i dus su/ rgyal po dang btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pas bskyal ba la/ btsun mo gnyis kyis bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu bskyal/ sang ni slob dpon rgya gar du gshegs pa la/ slob dpon kyi zhal nas/ do nub khyod gnyis la dbang bskur bas/ srod la dril bu gsil zer ba dang cog ro bza' ngang tshul shog tho rangs dril bu gsil ba dang*/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal shog /gsung skad/ der srod la dril bu byung ba dang*/ cog ro bzas phyin pa dang*/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ phug pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor/ rnam pa gsum lam me nam mkha' la sprul nas gda' skad/ der slob dpon gyis khyod nga las dbang len nam/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len gsungs pa la/ jo mo'i zhal nas slob dpon la de snga yang blangs/ phyis kyang blangs pas chog pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga las dbang mi len par nga'i sems kyi cho 'phrul las dbang len gsung zhal nag thing song skad/ der dbang gdams ngag bshad/ sku la sogs pa 'jigs che zhing byin rlabs chung ba lags par gda'/ yang tho rangs dril bu'i gsil zer ba dang*/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis byon pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa snga ma sprul nas gda' skad/ der slob dpon gyi zhal nas snga ma ltar dbang gang las len gsungs pa dang*/ jo mo'i zhal nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang sngar yang blangs/ da rung phyis kyang blangs pas chog nga 'bu slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor las len gsungs pas/ slob dpon yang mnyes nas/ gdams ngag yang zab/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa yin gsungs/

de'i tshe slob dpon gyi yungs kar 'bru bdun gnang nas nam gtug pa'i dus su 'di nga'i phyogs su gtor gsungs/ tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ nga dang yang mjal yong gsung ba lags par gda'/ de nas de kho na ltar bsgrub pa byed cing bzhugs pa'i dus su/ pha ming gi bag mar gtong ba la phug pa nas 'brur byung ba la/ de'i dus kyi sngar gyi yungs kar gtor bas sku'i steng du babs pas/ slob dpon gyi phung byed sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ khro bo arya a tsa la sogs pa btang nas khro bos pho lha'i 'grams pa bcag ma bzhis rta'i sug pa bzhi nas nam mkha' la btegs nas lho brag mkhar chur bskyal te/ der bsgrub pa mdzad pas mchog thob ste slob dpon gyi spyan sngar phyin te/ da lta yang bzhugs par gda' ste/ jo mo cog ro bza'/ phyis grir shi/ chos kyang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa med gsungs/ mkhar chen bza'i brgyud pa yang sna nam bza' chos kyi sgrol ma dbang phyug yin te/ chos rje yab sras kyi yang phur pa jo mo lugs 'di thugs dam yin te/ mgro mgon nyid kyang thugs dam mdzad/ de ci la gleng langs na/ dbang bgyi ba 'di bla ma'i sku las thob dgos pa yin/ dbang gi go chod pa sems la dbang bya ba yin gsung*/// / 1$0000240775) ༄// bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrubs thabs//1$0000360 swa bhā wa brjod nas/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung nas kha ṭwaṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra sil bu grol ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sna tshogs padma rin po che'-i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

de'i mdun du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po zlum po/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa dngul dkar gyi me long 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gsal ba 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thugs khar 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' sku la gsol ba/ shin tu 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud drag po'i las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la myur ba/ mthu stobs dang 'phrin las la thogs pa med pa/ bdud bzhi'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi rtsibs kyi gdan la/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ g.yon pas dam nyams kyi snying khrag gtso mo'i zhal du stobs pa/ glang chen gyi pags pa sku la gsol zhing*/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi rtsibs kyi gdan la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtsug na nor bu/ sku mdog dkar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa rin po ches gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis sku la brgyan cing*/ dar ljang gu'i na bza' sku la lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ g.yon rtsibs kyi gdan la/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu/ sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas dbang gi rkyal pa bsnams pa/

g.yon pa thod pa nor bus gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza' sku la gsol zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis spras pa/ rgyab kyi rtsibs gdan la/ dbang gi mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba'i dgra gegs kyi srog rtsa gcod cing*/ g.yon pa zas nor dang phya g.yang thams cad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' sku la gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi po thams cad kyang gtso mo la 'dun pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing*/ bka' nyan cing gsung sgrub pa gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ayon gyi gnas dang*/ bka' dang dam tshig gi gzhal yas nas/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma la/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra 'u ru ru si li li skad cig gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ oṃ gha mu a tsitta shwa ra dharmā dzñā na sa mā ya/ arghaṃ nas shapta pra tī tstsha ye swa hā/ hūm̐ nam mkha' mthing bzang g.yu 'od 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// mu men mthing gi g.yu brag gter sgrom nas// che zhe chen mo a phyi sna nam bza'// dgra gegs 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// bdud bzhi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// dar dkar na bza' bdud rigs zil gyis gnon// zhi ba'i 'dzum ldan rin chen brgyan gyis spras// srid pa gsum gsal dngul dkar me long g.yas// dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i nor bu g.yon na 'dzin// mthu stobs thogs med a phyi chos kyi sgron// ayon gnas dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// spyan 'dren mchod phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ dharmā tā ra padma surya maṇḍal la hūm̐

hūm̐ ye shes mkha' 'gro gtsug na nor bu ni// sku mdog dkar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// dar gyi na bza' ind+ra ni li'i mdog /sku la gsol zhing rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can// phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pa thod pa rin po che yis bskang*// padma'i gdan bzhengs gtso mo'i bka' nyan sgrub// 'dod pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa po la stsol// rin chen rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis pad gdan bzhengs// ayon gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ badzra dzñā na tā ra padma maṇḍal la hūm̐ hūm̐ dam tshig mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu ni// sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas ne rkyal g.yon pa nor bu 'dzin// le rgan dar dkar na bza' sku la gsol// sna tshogs brgyan spras padma'i gdan la bzhengs// gtso la 'dun phyir sems can dbul ba sel// dngos grub gnang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ sa ma ya tā ra padma maṇḍal hūm̐/ hūm̐ dbang gi mkha' 'gro padma ra ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gcer bu grol// phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa lcags kyu 'dzin// gtso la 'dun phyir zas nor char bzhin 'bebs// thod rlon gyis brgyan padma'i gdan la bzhugs// dam tshig gnas dang mkha' 'gro pho brang nas// gdug pa 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ maṇḍal la ḍā ki nī dhe ma a tsakra maṇḍal la hūm̐/ hūm̐ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro za byed ma// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin// dur khrod chas brgyan sku la zhing lpags gsol// zhabs gnyis pus gtsug gtso mo'i bka' nyan mdzad// dgra gegs 'tshar gcod lha mo spyan 'dren gyi// bar chad sel phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bi shwa ra ḍā ki nī tā ra maṇḍal la hūm̐/ hūm̐ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/

rdo rje rigs kyi las byed mkha' 'gro dang*/ rin chen/ padma/ las/ sangs rgyas/ sku gsung thugs kyi yang sprul mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// las kyi mkha' 'gro za byed 'bum gyis bskor// dam nyams srog la rngams shing khrag 'thung ma// lce spyang sngon mo'i tshogs rnams phyi bzhin 'brengs// bdud mo las byed srog la rngams shing rgyugs// gdug pa 'dul ba bshan pa dmar po'i tshogs// dam nyams srog rtsa gcod phyir gnas 'dir byon// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// bdag la ngan sems 'chang ba'i dgra bo 'di// rings par khug la myur du sgrol bar gyis// sod rol sgrol cig chings gtubs sa ma ya// ma g.yel ma g.yel sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dgra la dal yams dmar nad khrag gzer phob// ma cig mkha' 'gro drag mo'i tshogs bcas rnams// nam mkha'i lha dang sdongs la gzugs phung phrol// dgra gegs log par lta ba sgrol bar bgyi// sa gzhi klu dang sdongs gzugs phung phrol// skye mched tshogs rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlogs// bar snang gnyan dang sdongs la gzugs phung phrol// sems can ngan sems 'chang ba phung bar mdzod// dmar gyi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes// bdag gi bcol ba'i las kyi 'bras bu de// deng 'dir mchis par mdzod cig mthu rtsal can//

zhes spyan drangs mchod pa 'bul/ gtor ma btang*/ phrin las bcol/ ci 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtso mo'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po'i mtha' bskor du 'gal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis kyang bzlas pa byed pa bsgom la bzlas so// oṃ gha mu a tsitta shwa ra dharmā tā ra ma ma tsakra swa hā/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ rā dza rā dza 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki nī ma ma a yu puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye 'dus/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swa hā/ bar 'dir bskang yig bklags/ bstod pa gang shes bya/ hūm̐ bzhin bzang dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar 'gyur med 'gyings bag ldan// 'khor ba'i log lta skem byed 'od lnga ma// bde chen dga' ster rab dgyes dpa' mo ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bzhin bzang 'dzum pa'i nyams// g.yas pa mi thod ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas dam nyams snying khrag dron mo 'thung*// za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' sku la gsol// rin chen brgyan dang dar gyi cod pan 'phur// chibs su sprin gseb chu rta sngo nag bcibs// rin chen gong smed mu men yob chen 'khrol// gser srab g.yu mthur dar sna lnga yis brgyan// za 'og dar stan gser sga'i sga steng du// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo bzhad chod tshul// gar dgu'i nyams ldan pho nya cho 'phrul 'gyed// lha min gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// 'phrin las bzhi ldan spros med ngang tshul can// bar kun sel 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol// phun sum tshogs gnas dpal gyi 'bri gung 'dir// longs spyod spel phyir bka' srung kun mdzad ma// bstan pa bsrung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo ye shes sgron// sku dog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// rgyas pa'i las mdzad phyag g.yas ḍā ru 'khrol// g.yon pa bandha rin po che yis bskang*// ind+ra ni la dar gyi na bza' gsol// chibs su 'brong bu kham pa rab bcibs nas// rgyas pa'i las byed rang mthun 'khor gyis bskor// bstan pa srung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs// hūm̐

dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo dam tshig sgron// sku mdog dmar skya rin chen 'od 'phro zhing*// dgos 'dod thams cad char ltar 'bebs mdzad ma// phyag g.yas ne'u le'i rkyal pas dngos grub ster// g.yon pa 'dod rgu bsgrub pa'i nor bu 'dzin// bai ḍūrya dang padma ra gas spras// rin chen char rgyun sgrub pa po la 'beb// chibs su cang shes la bcibs stong gsum nyul// 'khor du dbang phyug lha mo 'bum gyis bskor// dngos grub gnang phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul phywa g.yang longs spyod spel/ hūm̐ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo dbang gi sgron// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa gri gug 'phyar// g.yon pa zas nor bsdud pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin// thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyang*// srid gsum dbang bsdud chibs su mkha' lding bcibs// dbang gi las byed rang mthun 'khor gyis bskor// mi 'dzad nor dang rkang bzhi sma g.yang zas// che btsan mthu dang snang srid gsal ba'i spra// srid gsum rigs rgyud la sogs dngos grub tshogs// 'dod pa'i don grub dbang bsdud mkha' 'gro ma// dngos grub gnang phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam brgyud bskul khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ hūm̐ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro srog gi bdag /stobs chen drag mo sha za'i dus la bab// sku mdog mthing nag khrag 'thung snying 'byin ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu khros pa'i sku// phyag g.yas ral gris dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// g.yon pas thod khrag gtso mo'i zhal du stobs// glang chen ko rlon stag pags sku la gsol// dur khrod chas brgyan brgya bong ga pa bcibs// las kyi mkha' 'gro sha za khrag 'thung ma// rang 'dra za byed bdud mo 'bum gyis bskor// rngams shing rngams shing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod// rnal 'byor bka' nyon dgos pa'i las la rgyugs// gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs kyi bla srog khug

/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bstan pa drag tu bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// khyad par chos rje'i bka' srung thugs dam can// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po srungs// zas su dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor bzhes// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos mdzad pa 'di/ sgrubs thag shin du nye zhing byin che ba/ phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyang 'di'i don la brtson par bya'o/// // /bstan srung 1$0000240a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i bskang ba nor bu'i phreng ba// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig a phyi'i gsol kha byed par 'dod pas/ gtor ma dang mchod pa'i yo byad/ bdud rtsi sman rakta zas phud rnam pa sna tshogs pa bsags la 'di skad do//1$0000360 1$0000360hūm̐ ayon dur khrod gzhal yas nas// dbus phyogs sangs rgyas dpal 'bar ma// dmigs med snying rje'i rang bzhin sku// sku dog dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan/ khro zhal spyan gsum zhi khro'i ngang*// rtog 'jom phag zhal rin chen dang*// rus pas brgyan zhing gri thod 'dzin// gar stabs pad nyi'i gdan la bzhengs// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'khor gyis bskor// rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang*// sa chu me rlung rnam par dag /me long mnyam nyid sor rtog dang*// bya grub ye shes bzhi y-i sku// rdo rje rin chen padma dang*// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'phrin las gtso// rang rang rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin dpag med dang*// dmar gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod dang*// spyan gzigs sna tshogs rin chen spungs pa yi// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yang sprul ma// ayon gnas byon a phyi chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// srid pa gsum gsal dngul dkar me long bsnams// dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu g.yon na bsnams// dar chen sna lnga'i na bza' sku la gsol// zhi ba'i 'dzum ldan rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// dar chen cod pan 'phur zhing bdud bzhi'i gdan la bzhengs// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// a phyi chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i dbyings phyug thugs dam bskang*// yon chab me tog bdug spos sna tshogs dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med dang*// gtor ma 'bru bcud sna lngas brgyan// mda' dar stag ras me long gser g.yus brgyan// legs par btsugs nas gser skyems bdud rtsi bran// 'dod yon longs spyod phun tshogs ldan pa yi// chos kyi sgron ma'i thugs dam bskang*// rta sngon sga srab brgyan pa yis// a phyi chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*// dkor bdag chen mo bzhugs pa'i phyir// dkor mdzod nor gyis thugs dam bskang*// rten gtor chen mos thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig nyams chag sor bskong shog

/rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐ dpal ldan lha mo gtsug na nor bu ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar ser can// dar gyi na bza' in dra nī la'i mdog /sku la gsol zhing dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can// rin chen dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag padma'i gdan la bzhengs// phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ru snyan pa 'khrol// g.yon pa thugs kar thod pa rin chen bsnams// gtso la 'dun phyir dngos grub kun stsol ma// rang 'byung rnam dag ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i// sprul pa dam tshig dngos grub bsrung mdzad ma// ye shes sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro tshogs dang bcas// gtsug na rin chen thugs dam bskang*/ rta mchog gro dkar sga srab brgyan pa dang*// dmar gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// mchod yon rnam lnga tshogs kyi zhal zas ldan// dar zab rin chen rten rdzas phun tshogs kyi// ye shes sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// dbang gi mtshan du gsol ba yi// gtsug na rin chen thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam dbyings su bskong gyur nas// bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// bsam pa'i don grub bar chad zhi ba dang*// bstan pa dar zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ dpal ldan lha mo padma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gcer bur grol// thod pa lngas brgyan padma'i gdan la bzhengs// phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa lcags kyu bsnams// dbang gi ngang tshul padma mkha' 'gros bskor// drag po'i skur ston che gtsigs rngams pa'i zhal// dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba ni// dmar gyi gtor ma raktas bran pa dang*// tshogs kyi mchod pa bdud rtsi sman rag dang*// 'bras bu sna lnga phun sum tshogs pa dang*// mda' dar rten rdzas ral gri 'bar ba yi// thugs dam gnyan po bskong gyur cig

/rta dmar zhur yag sga srab brgyan pa dang*// sba lcags tshigs gsum leb rgan dar chen brgyan// mkha' 'gro chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// dam tshig sor bskong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ hūm̐ dpal ldan lha mo yid bzhin nor bu ni// sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// leb rgan dar chen na bza' sku la gsol// phyag g.yas ne le g.yon pa nor bu 'dzin// rin po ches brgyan spyi gtsug nor bu dang*// ind+ra ni la bai ḍūr sna tshogs mtshon// dngos grub char 'bebs dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma// gtso la 'dun phyir gnod sbyin mkha' 'gros bskor// dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang*// 'dod yon mchod sprin sna tshogs dang*// mtshan ldan thod pa bdud rtsis bskang*// gtor ma dkar dmar brgyan pa yis// dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// 'brong chen 'gying ba brgyan pa yis// gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// dngos grub 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang*// tshogs mchod dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// 'bru sna rin chen dar zab rnams// legs par brgyan pas thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa yis// rkyen ngan bzlog cing bar chad zhi ba dang*// khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad la// mi 'dzad nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rin chen 'bru yi char pa dbab du gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro chen mo ni// sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams// zhing lpags gsol zhing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// spyan gsum khro tshul zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// gdug pa'i sha khrag zhal du stob byed cing*// sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor// phrin las mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma dang*// dgra gegs ling gas brgyan pa yis// sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// sman raka tshogs dang bdud rtsi yis// mkha' 'gro za byed thugs dam bskang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyis// thugs dam dbyings nas bskong ba'i phyir// dkor mdzod chen pos thugs dam bskang*// 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mda' dar sngon pos thugs dam bskang*/

/rten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// zil mo 'bri dang shel sgong lug /gyi ling sngon po 'brong chen rgya bong dang*// dkor nor phyi yi rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// khrung khrung rgyal mtshan dar snas brgyan// nang gi rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// gser g.yu 'bru sna leb rgan dar// gsang ba'i rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// sku gzugs sba lcag sku yi rten// 'dzab dang bstod dbyangs gsung gi rten// dngul dkar me long thugs kyi rten// sku gsung thugs kyi thugs dam bskang*// bzang drug sman sna yon tan rten// yon tan rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// rol mo dbyangs snyan phrin las rten// phrin las rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// dpal ldan chos sgron 'khor bcas la// phrin las rgyun du bcol ba'i phyir// rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang*// mi 'bral rgyun du 'grogs pa'i phyir// rten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// mchod gtor rten rdzas dpag med kyis// rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang*// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// padma ḍā ki'i thugs dam bskang*// sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'bul ba ni// ljags la tshim byed ro mchog brgyad ldan bshos// spyan la tshim byed gzugs mchog yid 'ong dang*// snyan la tshim byed sgra snyan rol mo dang*// shangs la tshim byed bdug spos ngad ldan dang*// sku la reg 'jam bde bas thugs dam bskang*// thugs mchog bskong phyir chos nyid bde ba yis// bskang ngo mchod do ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir ma hā rakta dang*// nang gi longs spyod spel ba'i phyir// su ra chang dang ba la sha la sogs// sha chen tshogs dang tshil chen gsur dud dang*// ltag sprod rnga dang rkang chen dung la sogs// dbyings phyug lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// snying po 'dzab kyi 'phro 'du yi// mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// a phyi mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// lha min mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i bskangs ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / 777)༄// bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 1$0000360 a phyi bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ sems bskyed skyabs 'gro sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs pas stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las yi ge hrī:dkar po bsam/ hrī:de las 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod/ tshur 'dus hrī:la thim/ hrī:de yongs su gyur pa las/ a phyi sku mdog dkar mo/ sku bzhengs nas zhabs gnyis kyis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na dngul dkar gyi me long 'dzin pa/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gzigs pa/ phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsnams pa/ gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ de lta bu zhig bsgom la bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrī:dkar po la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ oṃ ma ma tsakra swā hā/ yar 'dus sarba 'dus/ rā dza rā dza 'dus/ ma ma 'dus hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ming tshig ma 'dres par bzlas/ de ltar bzlas pas rtags ni bud med chas bzang gis zas nor ster ba dang*/ me tog thu ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ ri la 'dzegs pa/ 'ja' tshon 'khrug pa/ 'bru'i phung po smin pa rnams dngos grub thob pa'i rtags so// shes pa 'tshig pa dang*/ khro 'dod pa dang*/ nyams mi dga' ba/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba/ rmi lam du bud med kyi tshogs 'khrug pa/ gos ngan pa mdze mo'i gzugs su byung ba dang*/ mtshan ma ston pa dang*/ chas ngan pa mi 'grub cing nyams grib phog pa'i rtags yin/ yi ge brgya pa 'don bshags pa bya/ thugs dam bskang ba de ltar byas nas bsgrubs na 'grub/

las phran tshegs bsgrub na/ sngags kyi gsham la nad rims la sogs bsrung na/ bdag la bsrungs shig rakṣa zhes btags so// gdon dang byad stem bzlog par 'dod na/ rbod gtong sarba bzlog /ces btags so// gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs gang 'dod sngags kyis kha bsgyur bar bya'o// brtan gtor la bstain par bya ba ni thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du gtor phye gtsang ma sman bzang drug dri bzang mngar gsum btab nas dpal bshos zur gsum byas la bzhag tha ma mtheb kyus bskor/ mda' bya rgod sgro can ma la dngul dkar gyi me long dang*/ dar sna btags/ gtor ma la gzugs/ dben pa'i gnas su mda' rgod sgro ma gsum gyi khri'u byas pa'i khar gtor ma zhal khebs bya/ thod pa de gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa'i nang du/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pas gang ba'i dkyil du a phyi bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim la 'di ltar gsol ba 'debs/ 1$0000360 hrīḥ sngon gyi thugs rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis/ chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes kyi sgrol ma/ dam tshig gi sgrol ma/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin brlabs la nye ring mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la gsal 'grib mi mnga' ba/ bdag la sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dbang phyug spel cig dpal dang grags pa sgrubs shig bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig 'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig bsams pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par sgrubs shig nyin gyi las su bya ra gyis shig mtshan gyi dus su mel tshe gyis shig / ces bka' bsgo la brtan du bzhugs pa'i pho brang du bsam/ rten 'brel snying pos me tog 'thor/

bkra shis brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bya// hrī: dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgrol// nyi shar gangs ltar dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan// "2 gzugs bzang gzi brjid 'od zer dra ba 'gyed// lta sdug yid 'ong a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// zhabs 'og bdud bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs kun gnon// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long mdzes pa bsnams// srid gsum snang mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yon yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// rgyal ba ma lus mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang*// sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod re bskong ma// tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mi'i mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas// bdud 'joms lha min g.yul ngo bzlog par byed// dkar po lha yi chab srid dbugs 'byin ma// 'phrin las bzhi ldan a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// srid gsum dbang bsdud 'gro ba ma lus skyob// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad// 'gro ba'i bsam pa chos bzhin bsgrub mdzad ma// yid bzhin bsam grub a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// byang chub thugs 'char kun bzang chos kyi sgron// lha mi 'jig rten kun tu skyob mdzad ma// gling bzhi kun tu rgyu ba'i drag mo rgyal// dpal ldan chos kyi sgron la phyag 'tshal bstod// deng sang bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan// dpal gyi 'bri gung thel du gdan bzhugs pa// chos mdzad sgrub pa po rnams skyong mdzad ma// bka' srung yang dag a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// bslab gsum rgyan ldan sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// zhing bsam dngos gsum rten cing 'brel ba rnams// ma nor tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas mchod gyur pa// ci 'dod dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyod la bstod cing gsol ba yis// 'gro ba chu bor bying ba'i ma rgan rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du mi btang zhing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//
